pois.label_en: Sample intake & queue board (do we need a second XRD?)
pois.detail: 全城的科学装置都是专用重器——FEL、冷冻电镜、深地实验室——但一座工业城市每天的问题是常规的：这炉铁的碳含量、这批水的重金属、这袋土的矿物相。这间屋子就是答案：一套真空、气源、隔振基础设施，六台仪器，一个队列，服务约十五个送样资产。琥珀色看板上是六条队列的实时深度；样品沿地上那条蓝线从收样台走向中央制样岛——研磨、筛分、称量在岛上完成，瓶颈从来不在仪器，在制样。
pois.detail_en: Every science machine in this city is a special heavyweight - the FEL, the cryo-EM, the deep lab - yet an industrial town's daily questions are routine: the carbon in this heat of iron, the heavy metals in this batch of water, the mineral phase in this bag of soil. This room is the answer: one vacuum/gas/vibration infrastructure, six instruments, one queue, serving some fifteen sample-sending assets. The amber board shows live queue depth for all six lines; samples follow the blue floor stripe from the intake counter to the central prep island - grinding, sieving and weighing happen there, and the bottleneck is never the instrument, it is the prep.

specs.送样流: XRD 9 件/sol · IC 水样 6 · ICP 5 · 拉曼 4 · SEM 3 · GC-MS 2
specs.最忙仪器: XRD 利用率 0.375，平均排队 0.23 件

specs_en.Sample streams: XRD 9/sol, IC water 6, ICP 5, Raman 4, SEM 3, GC-MS 2
specs_en.Staffed window: 16 h/sol; water runs queue overnight on the autosampler

sim: **这个房间用多少电(账 D-M4)——一个交付时没人问、也问不出来的数。**本资产交给总控时带了门位、隔振输入和五条回引,**唯独没有一条电力线**。那不完全是疏忽:在器件三轮之前,一半的负荷根本没有数——CCD 制冷曾被当作 −16 °C 的单级珀尔帖(账 D-C5 把它挪到 −71 °C 的三级堆),ICP 的墙上功率从没跨过功放(账 D-M3 找出缺失的 579 W),SEM 枪的真空没有挂过泵(账 D-G3e 让离子泵变成寿命的全部依据),X 光管的发射伺服则根本没人计价。　现在加得出来了:**常开 3.4 + 占空仪器 35.1 = 38.5 kWh/sol** 在本馆端子上,若把城里为本馆制氩的能耗一起算,**82.0 kWh/sol**。其中 **3.1 kWh/sol 是三轮之前根本不存在的数**。　**真正该看的是比值**:制 6.42 kg/sol 氩要 **43.5 kWh/sol**,而全馆六台仪器加上所有泵、冷机、制冷器一共 **38.5**——**比值 1.13,这台仪器的气,和整个实验室一样贵**,而且是另一个资产、在另一条母线上,为一台 16% 利用率的机器花的。账 C 问的是「城里造不造得出这些氩」,答了是、余量 1.25;**它从没问过这些氩折成千瓦时,和消耗它的那台机器比是多少**。　顺带两条:账 A 那笔真空红利 19.7 kWh/sol 是真的,占本馆用电的 51%,**而且仍然小于那笔气**;以及电到底花在哪——XRD 与 ICP 占仪器用电的 **64%**,而拉曼(全册最长的一本光子预算账)只占 **0.9%**。**本册的功夫一直跟着物理微妙度走,不是跟着能量走**;这对一本设计册是站得住的,但得说出来,免得有人把账的长度当成重要性。
M/M/1 逐台记账（mars-analytic 账 D）：λ 按送样方点数——矿场每批、硫厂每班、水质每 sol、冶金每炉；服务时间含装样。六台全部 ρ<0.4，最深队列 0.23 件，单台配置成立。
『要不要第二台』给的是判据不是感觉：ρ=0.7 的排队拐点对应 XRD 17 件/sol。城市土方处理量翻倍之前，答案是不要——买第二台不如把制样岛再加一个研磨位。
到样是脉冲的（巡逻车每 sol 两班集中送样），消费是连续的——收样台和样品柜就是把脉冲整流成稳定进样的电容，与 ops-depot-01 堆场同一条排队论。
sim_en: **What this room draws (ledger D-M4) -- a number nobody asked for at handover, and nobody could have produced.** This asset went to the integrator with a door position, a vibration input and five back-references, and **no power line at all**. That was less an oversight than an impossibility: before the device rounds half the loads had no numbers. The CCD cooler was assumed to be a single-stage Peltier at -16 C (D-C5 moved it to a three-stage stack at -71 C); the ICP's wall power had never crossed the amplifier (D-M3 found the missing 579 W); the SEM gun's vacuum had no pump attached to it (D-G3e made the ion pump the entire basis of the emitter lifetime); and the tube's emission servo had never been priced. It adds up now: **always-on 3.4 + duty-cycled instruments 35.1 = 38.5 kWh/sol** at the room's terminals, or **82.0 kWh/sol** counting the city's cost of making this room's argon -- and **3.1 kWh/sol of it did not exist as numbers three rounds ago**. **The ratio is the result**: making 6.42 kg/sol of argon costs **43.5 kWh/sol** against **38.5** for every instrument, pump, chiller and cooler combined. **The ICP's gas costs about what the entire laboratory costs** -- spent by a different asset, on a different bus, for one machine at 16% utilisation. Ledger C asked whether the city could MAKE the argon and answered yes with 1.25x of margin; **it never asked what that argon was worth in kilowatt-hours next to the machine that burns it.** Two footnotes: ledger A's vacuum windfall of 19.7 kWh/sol is real, is 51% of the room's draw, and **is still smaller than the gas**; and the electricity goes where the attention did not -- XRD and ICP are **64%** of instrument energy, while the Raman, whose photon budget took the longest ledger in this book, is **0.9%**. **Effort here has tracked physical subtlety, not energy.** That is defensible for a design ledger, and worth saying so nobody mistakes ledger length for importance.

M/M/1 per instrument (mars-analytic ledger D): arrival rates from the senders - the mine per batch, the sulfur works per shift, water per sol, metallurgy per heat; service times include loading. All six sit below 0.4 utilization, deepest queue 0.23 - single copies hold.

The second-machine question gets a criterion, not a feeling: the rho = 0.7 queueing knee corresponds to 17 XRD samples/sol. Until the city doubles its regolith throughput the answer is no - and an extra grinding station on the prep island buys more than a second diffractometer would.

Arrivals come in pulses (rover delivery runs twice a sol) while consumption is continuous - the intake counter and sample cabinet are the capacitor that rectifies pulses into steady feed, the same queueing physics as the ops-depot-01 yard.
pois.physics: 共享平台的存在理由是排队论的：六台利用率 0.1~0.4 的仪器分散到六个厂站，就是六台大部分时间闲着、坏了没人会修的孤儿机；集中成一间屋，队列浅、维护共享、标物同源。仪器共享平台之于工业城市，相当于图书馆之于书。
pois.physics_en: The case for a shared platform is queueing-theoretic: six instruments at 10-40% utilization scattered across six plants are six orphans - idle most of the time, unrepairable when down. Pooled in one room they share shallow queues, one maintenance crew and one standards chain. An instrument-sharing platform is to an industrial city what a library is to books.

pois.label: GC-MS（火星没有氦,载气用电解氢）
pois.label_en: GC-MS (no helium on Mars - the carrier is electrolytic hydrogen)
pois.detail: 气相色谱-质谱联用：柱温箱里的毛细柱把混合物按沸点与极性拆开，四极杆质谱给每个峰称分子量。载气是这台仪器的血液，而地球的默认血型——氦——在火星是死路：大气里没有、地质氦藏没有、不可 ISRU，进口一瓶少一瓶。所以这台 GC 从第一天就烧氢：左下那只红标小箱是电解氢发生器，母管接 res-isru-01 的电解产线。柱顶转盘是自动进样器，八支样品瓶随它慢转。
pois.detail_en: Gas chromatography-mass spectrometry: the capillary column in the oven pulls mixtures apart by volatility and polarity, and the quadrupole weighs each peak's molecules. Carrier gas is this instrument's blood, and Earth's default blood type - helium - is a dead end on Mars: none in the atmosphere, no geological helium play, not ISRU-able; every imported bottle is one fewer. So this GC has burned hydrogen from day one: the little red-striped box at lower left is the electrolytic H2 generator, its header fed from the res-isru-01 electrolysis line. The carousel on top is the autosampler, eight vials turning slowly with it.

specs.载气耗量: 43 L/sol ≈ 3.9 g H₂/sol（柱流 1.5 + 分流 40 mL/min，3 针/sol）
specs.安全: 柱温箱 4% LEL = 2 L H₂，满流量泄漏 48 min 才到；断流传感器 5 s 切断
specs.四极杆真空: 涡轮泵排气 → 穿舱管线（见真空半价卡）

sim: **器件层(L3 轮 · 账 D-M1)——电子倍增器,烧氢的那一版。**城内已有一本倍增器账:sci-astro 的天体生物学 GC-MS 算过通道增益、驻留电流底与抽出电荷寿命(其账⑳㉑),得到 2.5 倍余量、跳过载气质量后变 1300 倍。**那份工作不在这里重做**——只问他们答不上的那一问:他们烧进口氦,本馆烧氢,载气改了会怎样。　会。70 eV 下 H₂ 的电离截面 **1.02 Å²** 对氦的 **0.35**——氢好电离 **2.9 倍**。把 sci-astro 那 4.0 C 按比例放大,本馆坐在载气峰上扫会抽出 **11.7 C**,而通道寿命是 10 C:**余量 0.9 倍,低于 1——倍增器活不到任务结束**,而他们的氦机器有 2.5 倍、勉强能蒙混过去。**同一台探测器、同一个扫描设置,载气决定了它是一个偏好还是一条生死线。**跳过 m/z 2 之后余量回到约 **446 倍**。　**还有一条负结果**:本账原本预期氢会带来自己的离子化学——H₂⁺+H₂→H₃⁺+H 是已知最快的离子-分子反应之一(2.1e-9 cm³/s),真那样的话载气就不是一个峰而是 m/z 1、2、3 三个。**它在这里不发生**:1e-2 Pa 的源密度下,1 µs 引出前只转化 **0.29%**;要跑完得约 **3 Pa**,那是化学电离源不是电子轰击源。**氢和氦一样,只占一个载气峰。**而运气在于:两种载气的峰都挤在 m/z 12 以下——有机碎片一个都不住在那儿。

**器件层(L3 · 账 D-G4)——没有氦的账单,在离子源上结清。**账 G 把氦划掉的理由很干净:氢载气 3.9 g/sol = ISRU 电解线的 0.014%。它同时把一根 **2000 K 的灯丝放进了氢气里**,而这件事当时没人说。账单不在会去找的地方:**蒸发完全不相干**(1.3e-9 Pa 蒸气压下,0.1 mm 钨丝掉十分之一半径要约 1800 年),而且**氢是还原性的,压住了真正杀灯丝的钨-水循环**(W+3H₂O→WO₃+3H₂,氧化物从最热处蒸走、沉积到冷处,于是丝在最热的地方最先细)——氦机器的灯丝死于它排不掉的痕量水,氢机器的不会。**火星拿走了氦,在这张台子上反倒还回来一根更长命的灯丝。**　账单落在了账 G4 头上。一个分析物分子在 1 cm³ 离子源里待 τ=V/C=**15.6 ms**,以 325 m/s 撞壁 **763 次**;灯丝占内表面 0.26%,于是**平均撞上灯丝 2 次**。2000 K 的金属在氢里就是一个原子氢源,而原子氢会把落上去的分子加氢、还原。这是几何上界(真源把灯丝藏在狭缝后,实际要小几倍),但**即使只剩十分之一也不是零,而零正是 G4 默认的**。G4 的整个论点是 70 eV 是计量不变量、五十万条地球 NIST 谱在火星仪器上照样有效——一个免费随船的谱库;而源内加氢会移动碎片离子比,移动了的谱是一次**悄悄退化的库匹配**。缓解办法两行,应该写在卡上:**用铼灯丝而不是钨**(钨与有机蒸气生成脆性 WC,铼不生成稳定碳化物,而这台仪器存在的理由就是看有机物),**并压住离子源温度**(原子氢产率与碳化物问题都是阿伦尼乌斯的)。**谱库仍然随船,只是不再无条件随船**——那个条件,是一根因为这颗行星没有氦才选定的灯丝材料。

五本账蒸馏（mars-analytic sim/gcms,20 闸全绿）。Golay 全曲线（G1）:H_min=2√(BC) 里扩散系数消掉——**H_min 与载气无关**(全部 0.196 mm,30 m 柱 15 万塔板),载气买的是速度不是塔板;u_opt 阶梯 N₂ 12/He 25/H₂ 37 cm/s 复现教科书,等效率下氢比氦快 1.44×。氦从来买的不是效率,是习惯——首轮卡的文献引用现在站在自己算的曲线上。

程序升温模型+SAM 制度（G2,L2 积分）:线性升温把 C12~C18 八个碳的挥发度差收敛到同一个洗脱 k=1.38±0.11——升温就是 k 伺服,保留指数因此在火星依然成立。**制度卡眼:MSL/SAM 的氯苯教训**——火星土 0.5~1% 高氯酸盐在进样口热解放氯,把要找的有机物当场氯化成伪影(2012-14 盖尔萨加)。馆规:土样先过洗盐前处理(res-eclss-01 高氯酸盐支线同化学),否则标『伪影可能』;每批跑程序空白。在盖尔买的假阳性教训,在耶泽罗花。
四极杆稳定图（G3）:扫描线骑在顶点 (q,a)=(0.706,0.237) 下方 1% 内,**质量轴就是 RF 电压轴**(严格线性,m/z 500=637 V₀ₚ=极间 2.5 kVpp);RF-only 前置杆截止 m/z 39——H₂⁺(2) 与 N₂⁺(28) 在头几个射频周期就被弹出,『氢载气淹谱』的担心死在稳定图上:四极杆根本装不下 m/z 2。

70 eV 不变量（G4,BEB 模型)——化学的铷钟:多壳层电离截面峰在 73 eV、60~80 eV 平坦 1.2%,能量设错 5 eV 谱强度都不动——这就是在盖瑟斯堡录的 50 万张 NIST 谱在耶泽罗依然作证的原因(阈值区 1 eV=73%,软电离永远成不了通用谱库)。谱库随补给窗进口一次,谱库的**有效性**免运费——物理背书。首轮 Lotz 模型峰位 40 eV 红闸后升级 BEB,修正入账。

氢安全动力学（G5,L2 ODE):柱箱漏氢 1.4 min 到 10% LEL 报警,联锁 5 s 断电解,单事件释放 0.22 L=0.02 g;全馆零通风 222 天才到 LEL,ECLSS 循环下稳态 0.0015 vol%(LEL 的万分之四)。**诚实氧注**:26.5% O₂ 舱气里氢可燃窗更宽、点火能更低——答案是架构性的(无气瓶,存量 0.5 L)不是规程性的:规程会失效,不存在的存量点不着。
sim_en: **Device layer (round 3 -- ledger D-M1): the electron multiplier, on hydrogen.** The city already has a multiplier ledger -- sci-astro's astrobiology GC-MS derived the channel gain, the dwell-time current floor and the extracted-charge lifetime (its accounts 20 and 21), finding a 2.5x margin that became 1300x once the scan skipped the carrier's mass. **That work is not repeated here.** Only the question their ledger could not answer is asked: they run imported helium, this bench runs hydrogen. It matters. At 70 eV the ionization cross-section of H2 is **1.02 A^2** against helium's **0.35** -- hydrogen ionizes **2.9x** more readily. Scaling their 4.0 C, a scan sitting on the carrier mass here would draw **11.7 C** against a 10 C channel life: **a margin of 0.9x, below one -- the multiplier does not reach the end of the mission**, where their helium instrument had 2.5x and could have got away with it. **Same detector, same setting, and the carrier gas decides whether it is a preference or a survival requirement.** Skipping m/z 2 restores about **446x**. **A negative result alongside it**: this ledger expected hydrogen to bring its own ion chemistry -- H2+ + H2 -> H3+ + H is among the fastest ion-molecule reactions known (2.1e-9 cm3/s), which would have put the carrier at m/z 1, 2 AND 3. It does not happen: at 1e-2 Pa only **0.29%** converts before extraction, and running it would need ~**3 Pa** -- a chemical ionization source, not an electron-impact one. **Hydrogen presents one carrier peak, exactly like helium.** The luck is that both carriers crowd below m/z 12, where no organic fragment lives.

**Device layer (L3 -- ledger D-G4): the bill for having no helium, paid at the ion source.** Ledger G struck helium off the manifest on clean grounds -- hydrogen carrier at 3.9 g/sol, 0.014% of the ISRU electrolysis line. It also put a **2000 K filament in a hydrogen atmosphere**, and never said so. The bill is not where it would be looked for. **Evaporation is irrelevant**: at a 1.3e-9 Pa vapour pressure a 0.1 mm tungsten wire takes ~1,800 years to lose a tenth of its radius. And **hydrogen is reducing, so it suppresses the tungsten-water cycle that actually kills filaments** (W + 3H2O -> WO3 + 3H2, the oxide evaporating from the hot zone and redepositing on cool surfaces, so the wire thins fastest where it is hottest). A helium instrument's filament dies of the trace water it cannot exclude; a hydrogen instrument's does not. **Mars took the helium away and, at this one bench, handed back a longer-lived filament.** The bill lands on ledger G4 instead. An analyte molecule spends tau = V/C = **15.6 ms** in a 1 cm3 source, making **763 wall collisions** at 325 m/s; the filament is 0.26% of the internal area, so **about two of them are with the filament**. At 2000 K in hydrogen that surface is an atomic-hydrogen source, and atomic H hydrogenates and reduces what lands on it. This is a geometric upper bound -- a real source hides the filament behind a slit and would cut it several-fold -- but **even a tenth of it is not zero, and zero is what G4 assumed**. G4's whole argument is that 70 eV is a metrology invariant, so half a million Earth-recorded NIST spectra are valid on a Mars instrument: a library that ships for free. In-source hydrogenation shifts fragment ratios, and a shifted spectrum is a library match that quietly degrades. The mitigation is two lines and belongs on the card: **run a rhenium filament, not tungsten** (W forms brittle WC with organic vapour; Re forms no stable carbide, and looking at organics is why this instrument exists), **and hold the source temperature down** (both the H-atom yield and the carbide problem are Arrhenius in it). **The library still ships -- it just no longer ships unconditionally**, and the condition is a filament material chosen because this planet has no helium.

Five ledgers distilled (mars-analytic sim/gcms, 20 gates green). The full Golay curve (G1): in H_min = 2 sqrt(BC) the diffusivity cancels - **H_min is carrier-independent** (0.196 mm for all three; 150k plates on 30 m). The carrier buys speed, never plates: u_opt ladder N2 12 / He 25 / H2 37 cm/s reproduces the textbook, and H2 runs 1.44x faster than He at equal efficiency. Helium was never buying efficiency - it was buying habit. The round-1 citation now stands on its own computed curve.

Ramp model + the SAM rule (G2, L2 integration): a linear ramp walks C12-C18 - eight carbons of volatility - to one elution k = 1.38 +- 0.11: temperature programming is a k-servo, which is why retention indices survive the trip to Mars. **The institutional gem: MSL/SAM's chlorobenzene lesson** - Martian soil is 0.5-1% perchlorate, and pyrolysed in the inlet it chlorinates the very organics being sought (the 2012-14 Gale saga). House rule: soil passes the wash-brine pretreat (res-eclss-01 perchlorate-branch chemistry) or carries an 'artifact-possible' flag; every batch runs a procedural blank. A false-positive lesson bought at Gale, spent at Jezero.

The quadrupole stability diagram (G3): the scan line rides within 1% of the apex (q,a) = (0.706, 0.237); **the mass axis is literally an RF-voltage axis** (strictly linear; m/z 500 = 637 V 0-peak = 2.5 kVpp pole-to-pole). The RF-only prefilter cuts below m/z 39 - H2+ (2) and N2+ (28) are ejected within the first RF cycles. The 'hydrogen floods the spectrum' worry dies on the diagram: the quad cannot hold m/z 2 at all.

The 70 eV invariant (G4, BEB model) - chemistry's rubidium clock: the multi-shell ionization cross-section peaks at 73 eV and is 1.2% flat across 60-80, so a 5 eV mis-set moves nothing - which is why half a million NIST spectra recorded in Gaithersburg still testify in Jezero (at threshold, 1 eV moves 73% - soft ionization could never become a universal library). The library ships once per window; its VALIDITY ships free, in the physics. Correction filed: the first-draft Lotz model peaked at 40 eV; a red gate forced the BEB upgrade.

Hydrogen safety dynamics (G5, L2 ODE): an oven leak alarms at 10% LEL in 1.4 min, the interlock cuts electrolysis in 5 s, a single event releases 0.22 L = 0.02 g; the whole hall needs 222 unventilated days to reach LEL, and sits at 0.0015 vol% steady-state under ECLSS circulation. **The honest oxygen note**: in 26.5% O2 cabin air hydrogen's flammable range widens and its ignition energy drops - the answer is architectural (no cylinder, 0.5 L inventory), not procedural: procedures fail; an inventory that is not there cannot ignite.
pois.physics: 氦在地球上也是不可再生资源——它是地壳里铀钍衰变几十亿年攒下的 α 粒子，逃逸到大气就一去不返，人类靠天然气田顺手截留。火星没有富集它的气田，大气逃逸更彻底。氢的分离效率反而更高（扩散系数大，van Deemter B 项和 C 项都占便宜），地球不用它只因为怕燃、且氦曾经便宜。把『曾经便宜』这个历史偶然拿掉，氢本来就是更好的载气——火星只是没有历史包袱的地球。
pois.physics_en: Helium is non-renewable on Earth too - alpha particles hoarded over billions of years of uranium and thorium decay, gone forever once they reach the atmosphere, harvested only as a by-catch of natural gas. Mars has no gas fields to concentrate it and loses its atmosphere more thoroughly. Hydrogen actually separates better (higher diffusivity helps both the B and C terms of van Deemter); Earth avoided it only from flammability fear and because helium used to be cheap. Remove that historical accident and hydrogen was always the better carrier - Mars is simply Earth without the baggage.

pois.label: ICP-OES（这台仪器在火星比在地球便宜）
pois.label_en: ICP-OES (the one instrument cheaper on Mars than on Earth)
pois.detail: 电感耦合等离子体发射光谱：把水样雾化喷进一团一万开尔文的氩等离子体，每种金属元素在里面发出自己的谱线——一针样品，七十个元素同时定量。窗口里那管蓝紫色辉光就是等离子体炬。它的胃口是每小时十几升氩气，在地球上这是 ICP 实验室的第一耗材账单；在火星，氩是大气分馏的副产品——火星大气 1.9% 是氩，摩尔分数是地球的两倍。全城唯一一台『搬到火星反而变便宜』的仪器。
pois.detail_en: Inductively coupled plasma optical emission spectrometry: the sample is nebulized into a ball of argon plasma at ten thousand kelvin, where every metal announces itself on its own emission line - one injection, seventy elements quantified at once. The blue-violet glow in the window is the torch. Its appetite is a dozen-plus litres of argon per hour - the first consumable line item of any ICP lab on Earth. On Mars, argon is a by-product of atmosphere fractionation: Martian air is 1.9% argon, twice Earth's mole fraction. The one instrument in this city that got cheaper by moving to Mars.

sim: **器件层第四轮(L3,COMSOL 磁场实解 · 账 D-M3)。**账 P4 的耦合效率是拿三个假设电阻搭出来的:R_coil=0.15 Ω、k²=0.3、R_match_shield=0.55 Ω——最后那个是在初稿算出 η=0.94(高于实测级别)之后补进去的。**三个假设调到答案好看为止,是这本册子里最不可辩护的一种数**,而它压着氩账的电力线。耦合是磁准静态加趋肤效应,可以解:27.12 MHz、三匝线圈通 20 A、绕一根导电氩柱,扫三个电导率。　结果一:FEM 给 **444 W 进柱**,折合归算电阻 **2.22 Ω**;而 P4 的手算变压器模型给 **2.22 Ω**——**差 0.0%**。**k²=0.3 是对的,ICP 的变压器图景过了全波检验。**　结果二(本轮头条):耦合功率对电导率**非单调**——300 S/m 给 419 W、1000 给 **444**、3000 只给 295。电导率上升会induce更多电流,但趋肤深度同时缩短,柱子开始屏蔽自己的内部,于是耦合在 **a/δ≈2.6** 处见顶——**而 P4 假设的那个 1000 S/m 正好在顶上**。所以那个 [A] 电导率之所以无害,不是因为它准,**是因为 ICP 会自己选到让它不重要的那个工作点**;上下三倍最多只差 33%。　结果三:铜线圈**几乎无损**——27 MHz 下 12.7 µm 趋肤深度给出 R_coil=**43.5 mΩ**,比 P4 假设的 150 mΩ 小 3.5 倍,单看线圈效率 98.1%。要落到实测的 75% 级别,其余电路得扛 **0.70 Ω**。**损耗不在载线圈里**——加粗铜管、加强线圈水冷买不到任何东西,杠杆在匹配网络和屏蔽罩上。　结果四,全册没人算过的数:**1350 W 射频前面是一台约 70% 的固态功放,也就是 1929 W 上墙,579 W 在一个从没进过本馆冷却账的柜子里变成热。**那个柜子现在建进几何了。

**器件层(L3 · 账 D-C3)。**账 P3 的检出限抄的是厂商级别表,而 `sim/icp` 里 grep 不到任何探测器模型。补上一个:一次进样要同时装下 14 wt% 的铁和 10 µg/L 的铅,信号跨度 **28 万倍**,CCD 的满阱除以读噪只有 **7 万**——**差 4 倍**。器件层的狠处不是削顶:中阶梯把约 50 个级次挤在同一块芯片上,饱和的铁沿列**溢出 156 行**,而相邻级次只隔 20 行——它把自己写进了别的元素的谱,这是任何光谱分辨率都解不开的干扰。三条出路:重新进样把氩从 6.4 顶到 **12.8 kg/sol**,直接击穿账 C 的 8 kg/sol 产耗闭合;同一炬二次读只花 **1.2 g**(贵的从来不是曝光,是等你决定时烧掉的氩);而**账 P3 当成隐患的 4400 条铁线森林,恰是免费那条**——挑一条弱 100 倍的铁线,跨度塌到 2800 倍,落回芯片量程内,而铁自身仍有 0.27% 的散粒精度,远好过主量元素所需。设计规则一句话:**按浓度选线**——森林不是隐患,是目录。
制耗闭合（账 C）：耗 6.4 / 产 8 kg/sol 裕度 1.25，后备 600 kg 工艺氩=93 sol——ICP 按日用仪器排班，不看瓶压脸色。氩是 eclss 进气塔冻 CO₂ 的副产（缓冲气本就 42% 是氩），精馏增量仅 ~1.5 kWh/kg；三个已知答案锚（SAM 实测 1.93%/地球 0.934%/厂商 12~20 L/min）皆非本册发明。

功率平衡（账 P1，16 闸深挖轮之首）：1.35 kW 里 **974 W 在把 15 L/min 氩加热到 ~4500 K**（80%）、230 W 辐射与炬管、气溶胶杂务只有 9 W——等离子体首先是台气体加热器，分析物搭 0.7% 的便车。**氮反事实**：同炬同流量烧 N₂ 要 2.8 kW（转动比热+9.76 eV 解离税）——缓冲气 58% 是氮，炬管仍然烧氩：行星给氩定了低价（账 C），物理又给它免了税（本账），两个独立理由指向同一种气。

雾化链（账 P2）：Nukiyama-Tanasawa 初级雾滴 d32≈49 µm，旋流室 10 µm 截止只放行 **1.1%**（对数正态尾部积分——教科书人人引用、无人推导的 1~3% 在此导出）；d² 定律核对：截止直径恰等于等离子体热区能烘干的极限——**排掉 98% 买的是安静**：湿滴穿过等离子体就是一条冷通道=全元素闪烁噪声。火星注脚：排液回 eclss 灰水线，废流在这颗星球上是绕行不是损失。

铁森林与检出限（账 P3）：Fe 在 200~300 nm 有 ~4,400 条谱线，平均间距 23 pm 对 10 pm 分辨率——任一分析线 59% 概率有铁邻居（蒙卡复核 58%）→ **双谱线确认是结构性馆规**不是谨慎癖。检出限对水质任务：Cd 10×/Cr 71× 从容，**Pb 2×/As 1.2× 边缘——复核线公开自己的弱项**，预浓缩在案、ICP-MS 在愿望单：夸大余量的复核者比没有更糟。

RF 与点火（账 P4）：27.12 MHz 趋肤深度 3.1 mm——RF 加热一圈甜甜圈，样品走中间凉隧道（这就是 P2 雾滴纪律的下游原因）；耦合 76%（线圈之外匹配网络+屏蔽涡流是真寄生，首版只记线圈 0.94 已修正）。**Paschen 一条曲线两种读法**：X2 里 35 kV 不许打火→舱内间隙 ×1.45；这里点火器必须打火→舱内电压省 31%。排风 1.1 kW 热氩入管道=4.4 kWh/sol 交给大厅空调账。
sim_en: **Device layer, round four (L3, COMSOL magnetic fields -- ledger D-M3).** Ledger P4 assembled its coupling efficiency from three assumed resistances: R_coil = 0.15 ohm, k^2 = 0.3, and a R_match_shield = 0.55 ohm added after a first draft returned eta = 0.94, above the measured class. **Three assumptions adjusted until the answer looked right is the least defensible shape a number can take in this book**, and this one carries the argon ledger's power line. Coupling is magnetoquasistatics plus a skin effect, so it can be solved: 27.12 MHz, a three-turn coil at 20 A around a conducting argon column, swept over three conductivities. **Result one**: the FEM puts **444 W into the column**, a referred resistance of **2.22 ohm** -- and P4's hand transformer model gives **2.22 ohm**, agreeing to 0.0%. **k^2 = 0.3 was right and the transformer picture of an ICP survives a full-wave check.** **Result two, the headline**: coupled power is **non-monotonic** in plasma conductivity -- 419 W at 300 S/m, **444** at 1000, only 295 at 3000. Raising conductivity induces more current but shrinks the skin depth until the column shields its own interior, so coupling peaks at **a/delta = 2.6** -- and the 1000 S/m P4 assumed sits exactly there. The [A] conductivity was harmless not because it was well known but because **an ICP self-selects the operating point that makes it not matter**: a factor of three either way costs at most 33%. **Result three**: the copper coil is nearly lossless -- 12.7 um of skin depth gives R_coil = **43.5 milliohm**, 3.5x smaller than assumed, for 98.1% efficiency from the coil alone. To reach the measured 75% the rest of the circuit must carry **0.70 ohm**. **The loss is not in the load coil**, so thicker copper and harder coil cooling buy nothing; the lever is the matching network and the shield. **Result four, a number nobody in this book had**: 1350 W of RF sits behind a ~70% solid-state amplifier, so it is **1929 W at the wall and 579 W of heat** in a cabinet no cooling ledger had ever been told about. That cabinet is now in the geometry.

**Device layer (L3 -- ledger D-C3).** Ledger P3 took its detection limits from a vendor class table, and `sim/icp` contains no detector model at all. Put one in: a single aspiration must hold iron at 14 wt% and lead at 10 ug/L, a signal span of **280,000x** against a CCD that holds full-well-over-read-noise **70,000** -- **4x short**. The device-level twist is not clipping. An echelle packs ~50 orders onto one chip, so a saturated iron line **blooms 156 rows** along its column while adjacent orders sit 20 rows away: the iron writes itself into another element's spectrum, an interference no amount of spectral resolution can undo. Three ways out: re-aspirating a diluted sample takes argon from 6.4 to **12.8 kg/sol** and breaks ledger C's closure against 8 kg/sol of production; reading the same plasma twice costs **1.2 g** (the expensive thing was never the exposure, it was the argon burning while you decide); and **the 4,400-line iron forest that P3 called a hazard is the free one** -- pick an Fe line 100x weaker and the span collapses to 2,800x, back inside the chip, while iron still returns 0.27% shot precision, far better than a major element needs. The design rule is one line: **match the line to the concentration**. Four thousand of them is not a hazard, it is a catalogue.

Closure (ledger C): burn 6.4 / make 8 kg/sol, margin 1.25, 600 kg standing = 93 sols - the ICP schedules like a daily workhorse. Argon is a by-product of the eclss intake tower's CO2 freeze-out (buffer gas is already 42% Ar), distillation adds ~1.5 kWh/kg; all three anchors (SAM 1.93%, Earth 0.934%, vendor 12-20 L/min) are imported, not invented.

Power balance (ledger P1, opening the 16-gate deep dive): of 1.35 kW, **974 W heats 15 L/min of argon to ~4500 K** (80%), 230 W is radiation and torch, and the aerosol's chores cost 9 W - the plasma is a gas heater first; the analyte rides along for 0.7%. **The nitrogen counterfactual**: the same torch on N2 needs 2.8 kW (rotational heat capacity + the 9.76 eV dissociation tax). The buffer gas is 58% nitrogen and the torch still burns argon: the planet priced argon low (ledger C) and physics exempted it from tax (this ledger) - two independent reasons, one gas.

The nebulizer chain (ledger P2): Nukiyama-Tanasawa primary spray d32 = 49 um; the cyclonic chamber's 10 um cutoff passes **1.1%** (a log-normal tail integral - the textbook 1-3% that everyone quotes and nobody derives, derived). The d-squared check: the cutoff equals what the plasma's hot zone can finish drying. **Draining 98% buys quiet**: a wet droplet crossing the plasma is a cold channel = flicker noise on every element. Mars footnote: the drain returns to the eclss greywater line - waste is a detour on this planet, not a loss.

The iron forest and detection limits (ledger P3): Fe carries ~4,400 lines across 200-300 nm - 23 pm mean spacing against a 10 pm instrument gives any analyte line a 59% chance of an iron photobomber (MC 58%) -> **two-line confirmation is a structural house rule**, not pedantry. Duty margins: Cd 10x / Cr 71x comfortable; **Pb 2x / As 1.2x marginal - the review line publishes its own weakness**, preconcentration on file, ICP-MS on the wishlist: a reviewer who overstates margin is worse than none.

RF and ignition (ledger P4): at 27.12 MHz the skin depth is 3.1 mm - RF heats a donut and the sample rides the cool tunnel through it (the upstream reason for P2's droplet discipline); coupling 76% (matching network + shield eddies are the real parasitics - the coil-only first draft said 0.94, corrected). **One Paschen curve, two readings**: in X2 the 35 kV must NOT arc, so cabin gaps grow 1.45x; here the igniter MUST arc, so the cabin saves 31% of spark voltage. And 1.1 kW of hot argon to the duct = 4.4 kWh/sol on the hall's HVAC ledger.
pois.physics: 等离子体炬为什么非氩不可：单原子、化学惰性、电离能适中，一万开尔文下不解离不成键，背景光谱干净。而行星大气的成分决定了谁的氩便宜——地球大气的氩也是钾-40 衰变几十亿年的积蓄，火星大气更稀薄，同一笔积蓄摊在更少的气里，浓度反而翻倍。res-eclss-01 的储罐卡说过『缓冲气成分是行星决定的』；这张卡是同一句话的收益面：行星也决定了这座城市的发射光谱学比地球便宜。
pois.physics_en: Why the torch must burn argon: monatomic, chemically inert, moderate ionization energy - at ten thousand kelvin it neither dissociates nor bonds, leaving a clean background spectrum. And a planet's atmosphere decides whose argon is cheap: Earth's argon is likewise billions of years of potassium-40 decay, but Mars's thinner atmosphere spreads the same hoard through less gas, doubling the concentration. The res-eclss-01 tank card said the buffer gas composition was decided by the planet; this card is the profitable side of the same sentence - the planet also decided that this city's emission spectroscopy runs cheaper than Earth's.

pois.detail: X 射线衍射仪，毅力号 CheMin 的地面版：钴靶 X 射线打在粉末样品上，晶格像光栅一样把射线衍射到特定角度——θ-θ 圆弧上，铜色臂是射线管（铜体钴靶），白色小盒是 192 通道硅条带探测器，中心是随旋台慢转的样品。它回答化学分析回答不了的问题：不是『有什么元素』，而是『原子排成了什么』。同样一份 CaSO₄，是无水石膏还是半水石膏，元素分析完全相同，浇进硫混凝土里一个粘结一个开裂。
pois.detail_en: The X-ray diffractometer, ground twin of Perseverance's CheMin: cobalt-target X-rays strike a powder sample and the crystal lattice diffracts them to specific angles like a grating - on the theta-theta arc, the copper-bodied arm is the tube (Co target), the white module is a 192-channel Si strip detector, and the sample turns slowly on its spinner between them. It answers what chemical analysis cannot: not which elements, but how the atoms are arranged. The same CaSO4 as anhydrite or hemihydrate is elementally identical - and one binds sulfur concrete while the other cracks it.

sim: 硫混凝土相闸（账 X6 蒙卡）：α/β 硫各自拥有距对方所有谱线 ≥0.8° 的指纹线（仪器 FWHM 0.08°，±1% 晶格不确定度下第 5 百分位仍 0.69°）——判相对光路误差免疫。石膏/半水/无水的最强线在 13.6/17.1/29.6°，一眼三档。15 分钟条带扫描的检出限 0.19 wt%（泊松蒙卡,√t 标度验证），40 分钟队列槽位=制样 20+扫描 15+判读 5,与排队账闭合。
晶粒统计蒙卡（账 X5）：被照体积 ~4 mm³ 里静置 40 µm 粉只有百级晶粒真在衍射,强度涨落 15%；磨到 10 µm 降到 2%,旋台再买 5.8×到 0.35%——制样岛的研磨机和样品旋台是这两个闸的硬件,σ∝d^1.5 标度蒙卡复现。CheMin 的振动样品杯是同一条账推到极限。
光路误差预算（账 X3,R=240 mm）：装样高度误差 20 µm → 0.0092°(2θ=30°),是唯一每次装样都变的误差项,主导 26~70° 工作窗;平板/轴向/透明度是仪器常数,被标物柜的 Si 640 内标一次吸收——富铁基体 µ=108/cm 反而把透明度误差压小(不透明样品是聚焦几何之友)。对齐预算:|s|≤43 µm。

**器件层电荷分享(L3,账 D-X2,TCAD 瞬态实解)——每个衍射峰下面那条低能尾巴有了尺寸。**把 6.93 keV 光子的 1900 个电子-空穴对注在不同横向位置、跟空穴漂到条带：条带正中心 **100% 独收**，间隙中点 **50/51 均分**，过渡宽度 σ=**8.9 µm**。而漂移扩散只能解释 3.4 µm——**求解器找出了缺的那一项：收集边界不是中点上的一条线，而是被 25 µm 注入间隙抹开的一带**（间隙里的表面场没有条带可指）。两个推论：①分享区由**版图**（注入间隙）定，不是物理定；②**从哪一面入射几乎不重要**（前照 30% vs 背照 35% 的间距占比）——一个设计者以为自己有、实际不存在的杠杆。代价是真的：**约三分之一的衍射计数以两个子能量事件入账**，落出分析能窗——这就是 D-X1 的窗不能无限收窄的原因：窗口收到一定程度，开始扑掉的是自家的共享计数。
矿场台阶圈定与真实案例保持首轮口径：硫要以斜方 α 结晶,滞留单斜 β 冷却数周相变收缩 6% 构件自裂——配比表看不出,衍射图一眼可见,res-sulfur-01 每批浇铸过此闸。
sim_en: The sulfur-concrete phase gate (ledger X6 MC): alpha and beta sulfur each own a fingerprint line >=0.8 deg from ALL lines of the other (instrument FWHM 0.08; 5th percentile under +-1% lattice jitter still 0.69) - identification is optics-proof. Gypsum/bassanite/anhydrite lead lines sit at 13.6/17.1/29.6 deg: three hydration states one glance apart. A 15-min strip scan reaches 0.19 wt% LOD (Poisson MC, sqrt-t scaling verified); the 40-min queue slot = 20 prep + 15 scan + 5 evaluation, closing ledger D.

Particle-statistics MC (ledger X5): in the ~4 mm3 irradiated volume, static 40 um powder has only hundreds of grains actually diffracting - 15% intensity scatter; grinding to 10 um brings 2%, and the spinner buys another 5.8x to 0.35%. The prep-island mill and the stage spinner are this gate's load-bearing hardware; the sigma ~ d^1.5 law is MC-reproduced. CheMin's vibrated cell is the same ledger at its limit.

Optics error budget (ledger X3, R=240 mm): 20 um of specimen-height error shifts peaks 0.0092 deg at 2th=30 - the only error that re-enters with every mount, dominant across the 26-70 deg window; flat-specimen/axial/transparency are instrument constants absorbed once by the Si 640 internal standard from the standards cabinet. The Fe-rich matrix (mu=108/cm) actually SHRINKS the transparency error - opaque samples are parafocusing's friend. Alignment budget: |s| <= 43 um.

**Device-layer charge sharing (L3, ledger D-X2, TCAD transients) - the low-energy tail under every diffraction peak now has a size.** Dropping a 6.93 keV photon's 1900 electron-hole pairs at different lateral positions and following the holes to the strips: a strip-centre hit keeps **100%**, a mid-gap hit splits **50/51**, and the transition has sigma = **8.9 um**. Drift diffusion accounts for only 3.4 um of that - **the solver located the missing term: the collection boundary is not a line at mid-gap but a band smeared across the 25 um implant gap**, where the surface field has no strip to aim at. Two consequences: (1) the sharing zone is set by **layout**, not by physics the designer cannot change; (2) **which face the beam enters barely matters** (30% of the pitch front-illuminated versus 35% back-illuminated) - a lever a designer would expect to have and does not. The cost is real either way: **about a third of diffraction counts arrive as two sub-energy hits** and fall out of the analytical window. That is why D-X1's energy window cannot simply be tightened until the fluorescence disappears - past a point it starts discarding the lab's own shared counts.

The mine bench-flagging and the real failure case keep their round-1 caliber: sulfur must crystallize orthorhombic alpha; lingering monoclinic beta shrinks 6% over weeks of cooling and the part cracks itself - invisible on the batch sheet, instant on the diffractogram. Every res-sulfur-01 casting lot passes this gate.
pois.physics: 化学计量学看守恒，衍射学看对称：元素告诉你有哪些积木，衍射告诉你积木搭成了什么。工业上大多数『成分合格却性能失败』的事故都藏在相里——钢的马氏体与珠光体、水泥的 C₃S 与 C₂S、硫的 α 与 β。所以原料控制的最后一道闸从来不是天平和光谱，是衍射仪：它是唯一直接看见晶格的常规仪器。
pois.physics_en: Stoichiometry watches conservation; diffraction watches symmetry. Elements tell you which bricks you have, diffraction tells you what they were built into. Most industrial failures that pass composition and fail in service hide in the phase - martensite versus pearlite in steel, C3S versus C2S in cement, alpha versus beta in sulfur. The last gate of raw-material control is therefore never the balance or the spectrometer but the diffractometer: the only routine instrument that sees the lattice itself.

pois.label: XRD 光源间（铁行星上选靶——CheMin 的答案,重算一遍）
pois.label_en: The XRD source bay (choosing an anode on an iron planet - CheMin's answer, recomputed)
pois.detail: 落地的油浸高压罐、上引的红色高压缆、铜体射线管——这个角落藏着本馆被账本推翻过的一个决定。首轮卡片写的是铜靶 Cu Kα,地球实验室的目录默认值。但这间屋子天天吃的是 18 wt% FeO 的耶泽罗土:Cu Kα(8.05 keV)骑在铁 K 吸收边(7.11 keV)之上,每个铁原子都被打出荧光,把弱衍射峰埋进背景;Co Kα(6.93 keV)在边之下,铁保持沉默。MSL CheMin 2012 年就为同一个理由飞了钴靶——本馆的账把这个答案从吸收边物理重新推了一遍,连同两条修正和一条负结果。
pois.detail_en: The floor-standing oil-potted HV tank, the red cable climbing to the copper-bodied tube - this corner hides a decision the ledgers overturned. The round-1 card said copper, Cu K-alpha, the Earth catalog default. But this room eats 18 wt% FeO Jezero soil every sol: Cu Ka (8.05 keV) rides ABOVE the iron K edge (7.11 keV), so every Fe atom fluoresces and buries weak diffraction peaks; Co Ka (6.93 keV) sits below, and the iron stays silent. MSL CheMin flew a cobalt anode in 2012 for exactly this reason - this lab's ledgers re-derived that answer from edge physics, along with two frame corrections and one negative result.

specs.靶: Co（Kα 6.930 keV < Fe 边 7.112 < Cu Kα 8.048——整个故事就这一行）
specs.荧光负担: Cu 每 Kα 打出 0.33 个 Fe Kα vs Co 0.11（中位 3×）——但器件层重算后这条只剩**速率负担**意义，窗内背景反而 Cu 低 236×（见 sim 层帧修正 #3）
specs.Kβ 滤片: Fe 箔 17 µm(1/25)+能窗 → Kβ 残余 9e-4
specs.球管: 35 kV×40 mA 线焦斑 0.4×12 mm,292 W/mm²,阳极峰温升 316 K(熔点余量 3×)
specs.70 kPa 舱内高压: Paschen 降额 1.45×:空气间隙 23→34 mm,发生器油浸免疫
specs.采样深度: Co 反而更深——Fe 边把『能量高穿透深』的常识在 7~8 keV 倒了过来

specs_en.Anode: Co (Ka 6.930 keV < Fe edge 7.112 < Cu Ka 8.048 - the whole story in one line)
specs_en.Fluorescence load: Cu ejects 0.33 Fe-Ka per Ka photon vs Co 0.11 (3x central, [E] band 2-5x)
specs_en.Kb filter: 17 um Fe foil (1/25) + PHD window -> Kb residual 9e-4
specs_en.Tube: 35 kV x 40 mA, 0.4x12 mm line focus, 292 W/mm2, anode peak rise 316 K (3x melt margin)
specs_en.HV in 70 kPa cabin: Paschen derating 1.45x: air clearances 23 -> 34 mm; the oil-potted tank is immune
specs_en.Sampling depth: Co samples DEEPER - the Fe edge inverts the usual energy-penetration order at 7-8 keV

sim: **器件层(L3 · 账 D-G2)。**账 X2 把管子跑在 35 kV × 40 mA、给阳极算了热,却从没问过阴极一句话。问了:要 **1.33 A/cm²** 才能从 0.3×10 mm 的发射带取出 40 mA,而蔡尔德-朗缪尔在 35 kV / 15 mm 下允许 **6.79 A/cm²**(204 mA)——**空间电荷不是限制,灯丝温度才是**。这台管子没有「电流设定」,只有一个必须被伺服到电流上的温度。灵敏度 **0.80%/K**:管流稳到 1%,就要把 2693 K 的灯丝稳到 **1.2 K**。而账 X4 的 LOD 按 √t 缩放——√t 压随机噪声,**压不掉 1% 的系统漂移**,所以两本账之外的一个计数统计结论,底下垫着一个发射反馈环。这是本馆推出来的第三个恒温器(D-W1 电导池 25 mK、D-C5 CCD 95 mK、这里 1 K/2700 K)。　韦氏电极怎么聚焦也解出来了:**靠饿死边缘**——栅在阴极电位时边/中场 0.909,−400 V 时边缘只剩中心的 **54%**。静电聚焦不是透镜,是挑哪一段热带允许发射;代价写在同一个数里:饿死的边缘就是你不再拥有的电流。凹进聚焦杯还把阴极场屏蔽到平行板值的 **76%**(2.02 vs 2.67 MV/m),而 0.0020 V/nm 比隔壁肖特基发射体低四个数量级——**X 光管要的正是一个能被控制的热阴极,不是一个会跑飞的场发射体**。交叉验证:1400 W ÷ 0.4×12 mm 回到 **292 W/mm²**,与 X2 给阳极冷却定的数一致,阴极账与阳极账在同一台管子上闭合。

选靶账（X1,5 闸）三条腿都不靠数据手册:①探测器负担——荧光光子在能窗甄别**之前**全速轰击条带,Cu 的到达通量 2~5× 于 Co(堆积与计数率是甄别前物理);②Fe 边反转采样深度,Co 在富铁基体里看得更深;③CheMin 先例。诚实对照:现代条带的能窗确实能把 Cu 的荧光剔到与 Co 相当(Fe Kα 距 Cu Kα 5.7σ,好剔;距 Co Kα 只有 1.8σ,漏 37%)——但那条路押在厂商剔除地板上,Co 的裕度不押。
帧修正 ×2 原样入账:首轮卡的 Cu 是没审计的地球默认值;而本账自己的第一版又把能窗方向想反了(以为窗口救 Co,实际救的是 Cu——救到平手,不是反超)。**负结果一条**:『降管压减荧光』的民间偏方在每 Kα 归一口径下失效——特征线产额 ∝(U−1)^1.65 与边上轫致积分随电压几乎同比缩放(30 kV/35 kV 比值 1.01),降压买到的是更慢,不是更净。

功率与安全（X2,4 闸）:阳极热用条状源+镜像汇的稳态叠加解,980 W 沉积峰温升 316 K,水路 4 L/min 温升 3.5 K 挂城网冷却环;打火账沿 phase-x 规则——串联电阻必须在管尖侧,杂散电容 50 pF=31 mJ 打坏靶面,1.5 pF=0.9 mJ 存活;围栏 2 mm 钢+1 mm 铅当量玻璃在 35 keV 端点透过 <1e-7。火星角在舱压:70 kPa 空气的击穿场强降到 20.7 kV/cm,每一条空气爬电距离 ×1.45。
探测器（X4,4 闸）:450 µm 硅在 Co Kα 吸收 95%(比 Cu Kα 的 86% 更高——软线反而好吸收,又一条钴红利);量子沉降分析判定系统为 X 光子限制,暗计数无关紧要;30 m 玄武岩顶盖把宇宙线压到 0.012 cps——地球地表实验室买不到的探测器指标,地下城白送(与 sci-rad-03 哨兵柱同口径)。

**器件层第三次帧修正(L3,Sentaurus TCAD 实解 · 账 D-X1)——荧光论据被自己的探测器推翻。**把 450 µm 高阻硅、75 µm 间距的条带真解一遍:电容矩阵 1.73 pF/cm(其中 76% 是**条间**耦合,背板只占 0.17——条带电容是横向量),漏电 167 pA/条,ENC 链算出最佳线宽 **270 eV**,远好于本册此前假设的 680 eV。用真线宽重算窗内背景:Fe Kα 距 Cu Kα 有 14σ、距 Co Kα 只有 4.6σ,而 **Fe Kβ(7.058)离 Co Kα 只有 128 eV=1.1σ,正压在分析线上**。结果反转——**铜的窗内背景比钴低 236 倍**(3.8e-5 vs 9.0e-3；首算漏乘荧光负载、多报了 8 倍，已自查修正)。这不是模型失真,这正是地球上真实发生过的事:能量甄别条带探测器问世后,『富铁样品禁用铜靶』这条老规矩已被很大程度解除。**首轮与第二轮拿来支持钴的荧光论据,到器件层没有活下来。**

同一轮还给假设的『甄别地板 1e-2』正了名(账 D-X1c):**它叫堆积**。电荷分享只会把事件能量往**低**处搬,永远无法把 6.4 keV 顶进 8.05 keV 的窗;能向上跨越的只有一件事——两个光子落在同一个成形时间里。于是账 X1 的『甄别前通量负担』与『窗口甄别』从来不是两条论据:铜 2.9× 的荧光通量逼出更短的成形时间(65 ns vs 钴 398 ns),短成形时间损失线宽,线宽损失又要求更宽的窗。一条链。

**钴凭什么还是钴(账 D-S3d + D-X1e)**:①**Fe Kβ 不可约**——冷到 253 K(31%)甚至用 SDD 级 125 eV(18%),它照样漏进钴的窗,而铜最近的铁线在 990 eV 外:更好的电子学只帮铜,救不了钴;②但换个方向看,这恰恰说明钴的窗内背景是**结构性**的、与探测器无关,所以钴的取舍必须建立在别处;③**采样深度**(Fe 边反转能量-穿透常识)、④**2.9× 更低的探测器速率负担**、⑤**黏土 d 值**——耶泽罗的层状硅酸盐 14 Å 基面反射,铜落在 2θ=6.3°、钴落在 7.3°,离直射光阑远 1.0°:长波长买到的低角可及性,任何探测器都替代不了、⑥CheMin 血统。**定版仍是钴,但荧光那条腿已经退役。**
sim_en: **Device layer (L3 -- ledger D-G2).** Ledger X2 runs this tube at 35 kV x 40 mA and prices the anode heat, but never asks the cathode a question. Asked: the tube needs **1.33 A/cm2** to draw 40 mA from a 0.3 x 10 mm strip, while Child-Langmuir at 35 kV across 15 mm allows **6.79 A/cm2** (204 mA). **Space charge is not the limit; filament temperature is.** A tube on this limit has no current setting -- it has a temperature that must be servo'd to a current. The sensitivity is **0.80% per kelvin**, so holding tube current to 1% means holding a 2693 K filament to **1.2 K**. Ledger X4 scaled its LOD as sqrt(t), which averages down random noise and **does nothing to a 1% drift** -- so a counting-statistics claim two ledgers away rests on an emission feedback loop. Third derived thermostat in the room, after D-W1's 25 mK cell and D-C5's 95 mK CCD. **The Wehnelt focuses by starving the edge**: at cathode potential the strip is nearly uniformly loaded (edge/centre field 0.909); at -400 V its edges see only **54%** of the centre field. Electrostatic focusing is not a lens, it is choosing which part of a hot strip may emit -- and the price is in the same number, since a starved edge is current you no longer have. The recess into the cup also shields the cathode to **76%** of the parallel-plate field (2.02 vs 2.67 MV/m); at 0.0020 V/nm it is four orders below the Schottky emitter next door, which is exactly right: an X-ray tube wants a thermionic cathode it can control, not a field emitter that runs away. Cross-check: 1400 W over 0.4 x 12 mm returns **292 W/mm2**, the number X2 priced the anode cooling for. Cathode and anode ledgers close on one tube.

The target ledger (X1, 5 gates) stands on three datasheet-free legs: (1) detector LOAD - fluorescence photons hit the strip at full rate BEFORE the energy window sorts them, and Cu's arriving flux is 2-5x Co's (pile-up and count rate are pre-window physics); (2) the Fe edge inverts sampling depth, so Co sees deeper into Fe-rich matrix; (3) CheMin precedent. The honest counterpoint: a modern strip's window really can trim Cu's fluorescence to parity (Fe Ka sits 5.7 sigma from Cu Ka - easy; only 1.8 sigma from Co Ka - 37% leaks). But that route bets on a vendor rejection floor; Co's margin bets on nothing.

Two frame corrections filed as committed: the round-1 Cu was an unaudited Earth default; and this very ledger's first draft had the window argument backwards (assumed it rescued Co - it rescues Cu, to parity, not victory). Plus one NEGATIVE RESULT: the folklore 'lower the kV to cut fluorescence' fails per-Ka accounting - characteristic yield ~(U-1)^1.65 and above-edge bremsstrahlung scale almost identically with voltage (30/35 kV ratio 1.01). Lower kV buys slower, not cleaner.

Power and safety (X2, 4 gates): anode heat solved as a strip source with an image sink - 980 W deposited, 316 K peak rise, 3.5 K across a 4 L/min loop on the city coolant ring; the arc ledger transplants the phase-x rule - the series resistor must sit tube-side, 50 pF of stray = 31 mJ kills targets, 1.5 pF = 0.9 mJ survives; the enclosure's 2 mm steel + 1 mm Pb-eq glass transmits <1e-7 at the 35 keV endpoint. The Martian line is cabin pressure: at 70 kPa air breaks down at 20.7 kV/cm, so every air clearance grows 1.45x.

Detector (X4, 4 gates): 450 um of Si absorbs 95% at Co Ka (vs 86% at Cu Ka - the softer line is the better-absorbed one, another cobalt dividend); quantum-sink analysis says the system is X-ray-photon limited, dark counts irrelevant; 30 m of basalt overhead crushes cosmics to 0.012 cps - a detector spec no surface lab on Earth can order, free with the undercity (same caliber as the sci-rad-03 sentinel).

**Frame correction #3, from the device layer (L3, solved in Sentaurus TCAD - ledger D-X1): the fluorescence argument was overturned by this instrument's own detector.** Solving the real 450 um high-resistivity strip at 75 um pitch gives a capacitance matrix of 1.73 pF/cm - 76% of it **interstrip**, only 0.17 to the backplane, so strip capacitance is a lateral quantity - and 167 pA of leakage per strip. The noise chain then puts the best linewidth at **270 eV**, far better than the 680 eV this book had assumed. Recomputing the in-window background with the real linewidth: Fe Ka sits 14 sigma from Cu Ka but only 4.6 sigma from Co Ka, and **Fe Kb (7.058 keV) lands 128 eV = 1.1 sigma from Co Ka - on top of the analytical line**. The verdict reverses: **copper's in-window background is 236x LOWER than cobalt's** (3.8e-5 vs 9.0e-3; the first pass forgot to weight the Gaussian leak by the fluorescence load and overstated the win 8x - caught in self-review). This is not a modelling artefact - it is what actually happened on Earth, where energy-discriminating strip detectors largely lifted the old ban on copper radiation for iron-rich samples. **The fluorescence argument that rounds one and two used to justify cobalt did not survive the device layer.**

The same round gave the assumed '1e-2 rejection floor' its true name (D-X1c): **it is pile-up**. Charge sharing can only move an event's energy DOWN; nothing can promote a 6.4 keV photon into an 8.05 keV window except two photons arriving inside one shaping time. So ledger X1's 'pre-window flux load' and its 'windowing' arguments were never two arguments: copper's 2.9x fluorescence flux forces a shorter shaping time (65 ns against cobalt's 398 ns), the short shaper costs linewidth, and the linewidth costs window width. One chain.

**Why cobalt is still cobalt (D-S3d + D-X1e)**: (1) **Fe Kb is irreducible** - cooled to 253 K it still leaks 31% through the window, and even at SDD-grade 125 eV it leaks 18%, while copper's nearest iron line is 990 eV away: better electronics only ever help copper; (2) read the other way, that makes cobalt's in-window background a STRUCTURAL fact independent of any detector, so the choice has to be made elsewhere; (3) **sampling depth** (the Fe edge inverts the usual energy-penetration order); (4) **2.9x less detector rate load**; (5) **clay d-spacings** - Jezero's phyllosilicates put their 14 A basal reflection at 2theta 6.3 deg with copper but 7.3 deg with cobalt, a full degree further from the beam-stop shadow: low-angle access that longer wavelength buys and no detector can; (6) CheMin heritage. **The verdict stands, but the fluorescence leg has been retired.**
pois.physics: 吸收边是元素的行政边界:边之上的光子有资格电离内壳,边之下的没有——差 0.2 keV 就是有和无的区别,不是多和少。地球实验室默认铜靶,是因为地球的样品平均不那么铁;火星表面平均 18% FeO,行星的地球化学替这台仪器选了靶。这与 ICP 卡『行星决定缓冲气成分』、GC 卡『行星决定载气』是同一句话的第三次出现:仪器目录上的默认值,都是地球的地方性知识。
pois.physics_en: An absorption edge is an element's administrative border: photons above it may ionize the inner shell, photons below it may not - 0.2 keV is the difference between everything and nothing, not between more and less. Earth labs default to copper because Earth's average sample is not this ferrous; the Martian surface averages 18% FeO, and the planet's geochemistry chose this instrument's anode. It is the third appearance of the same sentence - the ICP card's 'the planet decides the buffer gas', the GC card's 'the planet decides the carrier': every default in an instrument catalog is Earth's local knowledge.

pois.label: 拉曼光谱仪（车上粗筛,屋里定案——同一套谱库）
pois.label_en: Raman (rover screens, lab confirms - one spectral library)
pois.detail: SuperCam 的实验室版：绿激光打在样品上，散射光里千分之一被分子振动偷走一点能量——那点能量差就是化学键的指纹。光路桌上从左到右：激光器、转折镜、显微塔、光谱仪盒，绿色光路刻意露在外面。这台仪器的价值一半在光学，一半在制度：它与巡逻车桅杆激光共用同一套谱库、同一套峰位标定——车上打到可疑矿物粗筛报警，样品袋进城，屋里显微拉曼在同一条谱线上定案。两级工作流，一套语言。
pois.detail_en: SuperCam's laboratory twin: a green laser strikes the sample, and one photon in a thousand of the scattered light loses a sliver of energy to a molecular vibration - that sliver is the chemical bond's fingerprint. Across the optical table: laser, fold mirror, microscope tower, spectrograph box, the green path deliberately exposed. Half this instrument's value is optics, half is institutional: it shares one spectral library and one peak calibration with the rover mast lasers - the rover screens a suspect mineral in the field, the bag comes to town, and the micro-Raman closes the case on the same line. Two tiers, one language.

specs.送样: 4 件/sol，单件 20 min——全馆最快的定性线

sim: **满阱:从另一侧闭合(账 D-C6,L3)——外加一条我自己画错的结构。**账 D-C2a 把满阱记成负结果,理由是「孤立势阱不接任何电极,准静态解没有它的准费米能级」。那句话之后我又试了两次,**两次都失败**:先排空再抬势垒栅,DC 解七分钟只磨到漏极 0.87 V;改成三相同偏去读栅-沟道耦合,沟道电位在 0→−4 V 全程**只动了 1 mV**、电子密度只变 1.03 倍。　第二次失败反而解释了全部,因为它根本不是数值问题:**沟道从来没被耗尽过。**1.8e12 /cm² 的埋沟剂量、100 nm 栅氧,栅要先扛住沟道自己的施主电荷才谈得上势垒,那需要 **8.4 V** 摆幅——而这一族每一份 deck 都按 +8/−4 打时钟。**从来就没有阱可以孤立。三种方法败在同一个设计错误上。**D-C2d 的 MPP 时钟扫描独立撞到同一堵墙:抑制要过 −12 V 才开始,正是这个估计说耗尽开始的地方。　**而那次失败的扫描里,有一个可以直接用的量。**用账 D-X1 在条带探测器上立起来的端电荷法,dQ/dV 给出 **C_node = 56.3 fF**,对同一块 8×26 µm 栅的裸氧化层电容 71.8 fF 是 **0.78**——正是氧化层串联部分耗尽硅该给的比例。于是 FW = C·ΔΦ/q 变成一句话:**这个像元每伏势垒装 352 ke⁻**。**账 D-C1 与 D-C3 一直背着的那个 350 ke⁻ [A],等价于一个 1.00 V 的阱——正是科学级 CCD 的教科书设计值。**它没有被测出来,但不再悬空:置信标注从 [A] 变成「势垒 [A]、电容 [D]」。　留在台面上的:方法那句话仍然成立(要真测得带注入电荷包的瞬态);**改的是诊断**——D-C2a 怪了方法,方法没问题,是结构画错了。修法一行:栅氧减半到 50 nm,要求降到 4.2 V,落进正常时钟摆幅。**一本设计册可以在问题答完时停下,只要它说清答的是哪一问、没答的是哪一问。**

**器件层(L3,Sentaurus 实解 + 量子沉降账 · D-C1/C2/C4/C5)。**本卡头条的 28,000 cps 里藏着一个假设常数 `T_QE=0.10`,把整条光路和探测器揉成一个数。拆开是八级相乘 **0.241**——头条偏保守 2.4 倍,真值 **67,000 cps**,已知答案带仍然过闸。有用的是形状不是倍数:**0.93 是 CCD,0.259 是光路**,最差一级是 1800 gr/mm 光栅的 0.60。换更好的探测器只值 **+5%**,换 VPH 全息光栅值 **+42%**——这条杠杆此前不在账里。量子沉降在强峰上是光子(散粒压读噪 173 倍),读噪要到强峰的 **1/30000** 才咬人,所以探测器规格对本卡头条**完全不相干**;先咬人的是满阱——60 s 曝光落在满阱的 77%,离削顶只剩 1.3 倍,而这 60 s 和账 R3 为分辨率选的 26 µm 像元是两个互不知情的数字撞在一起。　**波长选硅**:532 nm 的 4000 cm⁻¹ 斯托克斯落在 676 nm,硅 4.3 µm 吸完,10 µm 薄片已有 90% 量子效率;换 785 nm 就落到 1144 nm、吸收长度 800 µm,薄片塌到 1%,连 200 µm 深耗尽也只到 22%。**账 R2 当年选 532 nm、用时间门而不是换红激光去对付荧光,顺手把探测器的硅也定了。**　**宇宙线**:火星地表 8.9 /cm²/s,60 s 曝光吃 950 条径迹、毁 2.9% 像素;地下城同一块芯片 **1.8 条**——**536 倍**(口径借自城内 sci-rad 两册,未重算)。SuperCam 必须拆多帧取中值,本馆可以一口气曝完——「实验室复核巡视器初筛」这条工作流,有一半理由是它在岩石底下。　**制冷(本轮自我推翻)**:先算出 −16 °C、单级珀尔帖加干氩吹扫就够;那是从目录里拿的 5 e⁻/px/s 推的。器件测量给 **1954**(工作态)到 **425,000**(未反型),低估了 391~85000 倍,设定点回到 **−71 °C**,真空杜瓦回来了。规则(冷到读噪限为止)没错,输入错了。
光子预算（账 R1,16 闸深挖轮）:拉曼是**百亿分之一**级过程(全探测深度散射比 2.5e-10),被三个乘数救活——1.6e16 光子/s 的激光、1e22 分子/cm³ 的固体、吞掉 8% 球面的 NA 0.55 物镜:石膏 ν1 在 5 mW 下 2.8 万 cps,10 s 积分 SNR 530。车上换角:立体角只剩 4π 的百万分之一,用脉冲能量补——同一本预算,两个对角。
荧光与门控（账 R2）:百万分之一的荧光杂质就把拉曼压 159×——基线纪律是生存问题。车的解是**时间**(SuperCam 100 ns 门:皮秒级拉曼过、µs 级荧光与白昼日光被 1.5e-6 占空比拒之门外——正午能测的原因);屋的解是**耐心**(3 min 漂白余 5% + 785 nm 对付顽固者)。一份谱库,两种纪律——首轮两级工作流的物理版。

光谱分辨率（账 R3,闸门定尺寸的真发现）:巴桑石 1015 与无水石膏 1017 cm⁻¹ 只差 2 cm⁻¹——**紧凑型 f=320 光谱仪 1.23 cm⁻¹/px 判了不及格**,研究级 f=750+1800 gr/mm 才给 0.52 cm⁻¹/px(2 cm⁻¹=3.8 px)。水合梯最窄的一档台阶给箱子定了尺寸;『2 cm⁻¹ 漂移致命』的首轮说法就此变成仪器规格,Ne 灯(原子常数,不坐火箭)月检压轴。

激光热纪律（账 R4,铁氧化物行星的功率旋钮）:点热 ΔT=P/(2πκ_eff·a),松散粉粒接触热阻再砍 10×——5 mW 打在玄武岩玻璃上升温 4000 K 级,赤铁矿安全功率只有 **0.77 mW**(对上文献 mW 级赤铁矿→磁铁矿激光伪影);石膏透明近乎免疫。馆规:未知样与铁氧化物默认 0.5 mW,亮相才升档,**功率升谱峰动=你在测自己烤出来的相**。选 XRD 阳极的那颗行星(铁),也拧了拉曼的功率旋钮。首版漏接触热阻+梯子排序反了,两处修正入账。
sim_en: **Full well, closed from the other side (ledger D-C6, L3) -- plus a structure I drew wrong.** D-C2a filed full well as a negative result: past pinch-off the storage region touches no electrode, so a quasi-static solve has no quasi-Fermi level for it. Two further attempts followed and **both failed** -- draining the well and raising the barrier phases ground the DC solve to 0.87 V of drain bias in seven minutes; biasing all three phases together moved the channel potential by **1 mV** across the entire 0 to -4 V sweep, with the electron density changing by a factor 1.03. **The second failure explains everything, and it is not numerical: the channel was never being depleted.** A 1.8e12 /cm2 buried channel under 100 nm of oxide needs **8.4 V** of gate swing before the gate has even supported the channel's own donor charge -- and every deck in this family clocked +8 / -4. **There was never a well to isolate. Three methods failed on one design error.** D-C2d's MPP sweep hit the same wall independently: suppression only began past -12 V, right where this estimate puts the onset of depletion. **But that failed sweep contains one thing worth having.** By the terminal-charge method D-X1 established on the strip detector, dQ/dV gives **C_node = 56.3 fF**, which is **0.78** of the 71.8 fF bare oxide capacitance of the same 8 x 26 um gate -- exactly the ratio an oxide in series with a partially depleted silicon layer must give. FW = C * dPhi / q then reduces to one sentence: **this pixel holds 352 ke- per volt of barrier**. **The 350 ke- that D-C1 and D-C3 have been carrying as [A] is therefore equivalent to a 1.00 V well -- the textbook design value for a scientific CCD.** It is still not measured, but it no longer floats: the tag becomes [A on the barrier, D on the capacitance]. What stays on the table: the method statement holds -- measuring a real well needs a transient with an injected packet. **What changes is the diagnosis.** D-C2a blamed the method; the method was fine and the structure was not. The fix is one line: halving the gate oxide to 50 nm halves the requirement to 4.2 V and puts it inside a normal clock swing. **A design ledger is allowed to stop when the question is answered, so long as it says which question it answered and which it did not.**

**Device layer (L3, Sentaurus + a quantum-sink audit -- D-C1/C2/C4/C5).** This card's headline of 28,000 cps rests on one assumed constant, `T_QE = 0.10`, with the whole optical train and the detector collapsed into it. Taken apart, eight stages multiply to **0.241** -- the headline was conservative by 2.4x, the real figure is **67,000 cps**, and the known-answer gate still passes. The useful result is the shape, not the factor: **0.93 of it is the CCD and 0.259 is optics**, the worst single stage being the 1800 gr/mm grating at 0.60. A better detector is worth **+5%**; a VPH holographic grating is worth **+42%** -- a lever the lumped number hid. The quantum sink on a strong band is the photon (shot noise beats read noise 173x) and read noise only bites **30,000x** below it, so no detector specification touches this card's headline at all. What does bite is the well: a 60 s exposure lands at 77% of full well, 1.3x from clipping -- and that 60 s and the 26 um pixel ledger R3 chose for spectral resolution are two numbers that met by accident. **The wavelength chooses the silicon**: a 4000 cm-1 Stokes shift off 532 nm lands at 676 nm where silicon absorbs in 4.3 um, so a 10 um chip already has 90% QE; off 785 nm it lands at 1144 nm with an 800 um absorption length, where the thin chip collapses to 1% and even 200 um of deep depletion reaches only 22%. **Ledger R2 chose 532 nm to fight fluorescence with time gating rather than with a redder laser, and in doing so silently chose the detector's silicon too.** **Cosmic rays**: at the Mars surface the quiet rate is 8.9 /cm2/s, so a 60 s exposure collects 950 tracks and ruins 2.9% of the pixels; in the undercity the same array sees **1.8** -- a factor **536** (calibres borrowed from the city's sci-rad ledgers rather than re-derived). SuperCam must co-add and median short frames; the lab twin can take the single long exposure. Half the reason the lab confirms what the rover screens is simply that the lab is under rock. **Cooling (retracted within this round)**: the first answer was -16 C, held by a single-stage Peltier behind a dry-argon purge -- derived from a catalogue figure of 5 e-/px/s. The device measurement gives **1,954** operating and **425,000** un-inverted, 391x to 85,000x more, moving the set point to **-71 C** and bringing the vacuum dewar back. The rule (cool until read-noise limited, then stop) was right; the input was not.

Photon budget (ledger R1, opening the 16-gate round): Raman is a parts-per-ten-billion process (2.5e-10 scattered over the probe depth), rescued by three multipliers - 1.6e16 photons/s of laser, 1e22 molecules/cm3 of solid, and an NA 0.55 objective swallowing 8% of the sphere: gypsum nu1 gives 28,000 cps at 5 mW, SNR 530 in 10 s. The rover flips the corner: one millionth of 4pi, paid back in pulse energy - same budget, opposite corners.

Fluorescence and gating (ledger R2): one-in-a-million fluorophores outgun Raman 159x - baseline discipline is existential. The rover's cure is TIME (SuperCam's 100 ns gate: picosecond Raman passes, microsecond fluorescence and daylight are refused at 1.5e-6 duty - why it works at Martian noon); the lab's cure is PATIENCE (3-min bleach to 5% + 785 nm for the stubborn). One library, two disciplines - the round-1 two-tier workflow, now with its physics.

Spectral resolution (ledger R3, a gate-sized discovery): bassanite 1015 vs anhydrite 1017 cm-1 - 2 cm-1 apart. **The compact f=320 spectrograph FAILED at 1.23 cm-1/px**; research-grade f=750 with 1800 gr/mm delivers 0.52 (2 cm-1 = 3.8 px). The hydration ladder's narrowest rung sized the box; the round-1 claim that '2 cm-1 of drift is fatal' became an instrument spec, and the Ne lamp - an atomic constant that rides no rockets - audits the axis monthly.

Laser-heating discipline (ledger R4, the iron-oxide planet's power knob): point heating dT = P/(2 pi kappa_eff a), with loose-grain contact resistance cutting the sink another 10x - 5 mW on basalt glass is a 4000 K-class oven, and hematite's safe power is **0.77 mW** (matching the documented mW-class hematite-to-magnetite laser artifact); transparent gypsum is nearly immune. House rule: 0.5 mW default on unknowns and Fe oxides, escalate only on bright phases, and **if peaks move with power you are measuring your own oven**. The planet that chose the XRD anode (iron) also set the Raman power knob. Two corrections filed: the first draft omitted contact resistance and had the safety ladder ordered backwards.
pois.physics: 拉曼散射是光子与分子振动的非弹性碰撞：散射光的频移等于振动模式的本征频率，与激发波长无关——这就是车上 532 nm 远距脉冲和屋里 532 nm 显微连续光可以共用一套谱库的原因：指纹属于分子，不属于仪器。千分之一的散射截面是它的代价，也是两级工作流的物理根源：车上靠脉冲门控压背景，屋里靠长积分换信噪，同一条物理，两种工程解。
pois.physics_en: Raman scattering is an inelastic collision between photon and molecular vibration: the frequency shift equals the mode's eigenfrequency, independent of excitation wavelength - which is exactly why a pulsed 532 nm standoff shot and a continuous 532 nm microscope can share one library: the fingerprint belongs to the molecule, not the instrument. The one-in-a-thousand cross-section is its price, and the physical root of the two-tier workflow: the rover fights background with pulse gating, the lab buys signal with integration time - one physics, two engineering answers.

pois.label: 扫描电镜（服务面最广的一台）
pois.label_en: SEM (the widest-serving machine in the room)
pois.detail: 扫描电子显微镜：电子束在样品表面逐点扫描，二次电子成像，纳米级形貌一览无余。立柱、样品室、交换舱门都是标准件，不标准的是它脚下——花岗岩惯性块坐在三只橙色气浮腿上（见隔振卡）。它的委托单最杂：冶金车间的断口该看韧窝还是解理，芯片厂溢出的失效分析，光伏板上的尘颗粒是棱角分明还是圆润带静电。一台仪器，半座城的显微眼。
pois.detail_en: The scanning electron microscope: an electron beam rasters the surface, secondary electrons form the image, nanometre topography laid bare. Column, chamber and exchange door are all standard; what is not standard is underfoot - a granite inertia block on three orange pneumatic legs (see the isolation card). Its docket is the room's most varied: fracture surfaces from the foundry (dimples or cleavage?), failure-analysis overflow from the chip fab, and whether the dust grains on the solar farm are sharp-edged or rounded and charged. One instrument, half a city's microscopic eye.

specs.电子枪: Schottky FEG（账 S1：18,000 h 发射体 ≈ 26 月补给窗——唯一不用等船的灯丝；1 nA 探针 5 nm）
specs.工作纪律: 本体冶金 15~30 kV；尘颗粒 5 kV（账 S2 蒙卡：15 kV 打穿 1 µm 细模态粒,台桩替颗粒作答）
specs.EDS: SDD 125 eV；MDL ~0.16 wt%；**硫行星禁用钼台桩**（S Kα=Mo Lα 差 14 eV 不可分）
specs.VP 模式: 600 Pa 火星 CO₂ 就是 ESEM 成像气体——穿舱线倒灌+滤尘+针阀,硫酸盐免镀膜
specs.送样: 3 件/sol × 90 min；客户：foundry 断口 · fab 失效溢出 · 尘形貌（fab 产线量测不出洁净室,分工不变）

specs_en.Gun: Schottky FEG (ledger S1: the 18,000 h emitter matches the 26-month window - the only filament that never waits for the boat; 5 nm at 1 nA)
specs_en.Operating discipline: bulk metallurgy 15-30 kV; dust grains 5 kV (ledger S2 MC: 15 kV punches through a 1 um fine-mode grain and the stub answers instead)
specs_en.EDS: SDD 125 eV; MDL ~0.16 wt%; **molybdenum stubs are forbidden on a sulfur planet** (S Ka = Mo La, 14 eV apart, unresolvable)
specs_en.VP mode: 600 Pa of Martian CO2 IS an ESEM imaging gas - hull line reversed through filter + needle valve; sulfates image uncoated
specs_en.Load: 3 samples/sol x 90 min; clients: foundry fractures, fab failure overflow, dust morphology (fab's in-line metrology stays in the cleanroom - division unchanged)

sim: **器件层第三轮(L3,COMSOL 静电学 · 账 D-G1/G3)。**本卡的探针梯子整个架在一张规格表的亮度列上。把那一列重建了:理查森-德什曼给热发射,COMSOL 解出的尖端场给肖特基降垒,朗缪尔极限把电流密度换成亮度——**W 3.9e4 / LaB₆ 6.7e5 / 肖特基 1.65e8 A/cm²/sr,对表里假设的 1e5 / 1e6 / 1e8,最差 2.6 倍,横跨七个数量级、三种机制**。场因子解出来 **k=5.98**(教科书球锥值约 5)。**S1 的梯子站在物理上,不是目录上**——确认性结论和推翻性结论一样值钱,只是安静。表里藏起来的是肖特基**为什么**赢:不是发射得更狠,是发射得更狠的同时还比钨冷 900 K,而 B=JeV/(πkT) 两头都收钱。　**但寿命那一列没活下来(帧修正 #4)。**闸 S1c 写的是「只有肖特基的寿命跨得过 26 个月补给窗口」——18,000 h 对 19,000 h,**根本没跨过去**,还差 1000 h,而且那是中位数,一半的枪活不到;两种方案都得带备件。质量不是理由(三种加起来 253 g,货运噪声);停机也不是(最差 2.0% 日历,排队论的 ρ<0.4 吃得下)。**活下来的是原账没写的那个计量理由**:换一次枪就是一束新电子,探针电流、束斑、探测器立体角全要重标——钨每窗口 **127 次**、LaB₆ 13 次、肖特基 **1.1 次**,而账 F 的溯源链是本地配标、26 个月货架,每次重标都在花它。**争的从来不是运费和工时,是「稳定的束流是一项计量资产」。**　更锋利的一条:18,000 h 本身是**一条穿着发射体外衣的真空规格**。它按 1/P 走,标在 1e-7 Pa;掉一个数量级到 1e-6(离子泵老了、或者一处慢漏),就变成 **1,800 h**——不比 LaB₆ 好,SEM 回到每窗口 11 次换枪。枪区那台离子泵不是装饰,是这条寿命的全部依据。

五本账蒸馏（mars-analytic sim/sem,20 闸全绿）。选枪的火星账（S1）:钨灯丝 150 h、LaB₆ 1,500 h、Schottky 18,000 h——26 个月补给窗 ≈ 19,000 h,只有场发射体的寿命跨过一个会合周期;钨丝按克进口很便宜,但每 150 h 一次换丝=排气-烘烤-抽气丢一天,一个窗口丢 120 天。亮度账同判:EDS 要 1 nA 进 10 nm,钨 59 nm/LaB₆ 25 nm/FEG 5 nm——只有 FEG 及格。

束-样品蒙卡（S2,单散射+CSDA）:η 阶梯 Fe 0.32/玄武岩 0.17/石膏 0.15——BSE 衬度就是这架梯子;**尘颗粒纪律**:z99@15 kV=1.8 µm,对 1 µm 细模态粒必穿透(对 2 µm 零余量擦边),5 kV 才 0.27 µm 包住 3.7×——尘形貌与尘 EDS 一律 5 kV,否则台桩替颗粒作答。pwr-storage-01/sci-ir-01 尘证据链的技术小字。
EDS 两条火星规则（S3）:S Kα 2.307 与 Mo Lα 2.293 差 14 eV,SDD 125 eV 分辨率下同峰——**硫行星的实验室禁用钼台桩**;Fe Lα 与 F Kα 差 28 eV 同样糊死——富铁基体里氟定量归 IC 线。MDL 0.16 wt% 对 ICP 的 µg/L 差五个量级:EDS 答『这颗是什么』,ICP 答『这水多干净』。

**器件层(L3,账 D-S3):两台硅探测器的真差别不是线宽。**TCAD 给出条带漏电**每 7.5 K 翻倍**(253/293/313 K 实解 2.6/167/931 pA——硅探测器的经典值,也与 phase-x 在另一种器件上重建出的 7.5 K 撞成同一个数)。冷却买的不是噪声,是**积分时间**:降到 253 K 让最优成形时间拉长 7 倍,线宽 270→151 eV。而 SDD 的 125 eV 里 **97% 是硅自己的 Fano 统计**——它已经贴着物理极限;冷却后的条带在同样成形时间下 157 eV,只差 30%。所以这间屋子需要两台探测器的理由是**几何与工况**(样品台立体角、单通道速率),不是线宽。**更硬的一条**:本卡上面那两条火星规则——S Kα/Mo Lα 差 14 eV、Fe Lα/F Kα 差 28 eV——**对任何硅探测器都不可分**(连 SDD 线宽的 12% 与 23% 都不到),所以禁钼台桩与氟归 IC 线是**绝对馆规**,不随器件档次浮动。
VP 模式=本台的『行星当耗材』卡（S4）:ESEM 工作窗 10~2000 Pa,火星地表 600 Pa 正在窗内——地球实验室买瓶装 CO₂ 做成像气体,这里开一只针阀(穿舱线倒灌+HEPA 滤尘)。3 mm 气程 100 Pa 聚焦保真 92%,全环境压 62% 仍可粗看形貌;绝缘硫酸盐免镀膜、表面化学不被 10 nm 金属埋掉。镀膜仪保留给 <10 nm 精查。
分辨率收口（S5,正交和,phase-x 信条）:VC-D 地板在 8 Hz 折合 124 nm 位移;**红闸真发现:气浮墩单级只压到 4.5 nm,吃掉全部 5 nm 任务余量——仪器机内第二级(f₀=2 Hz,FEG 镜体厂标)是承力件不是包装**,两级串联 0.3 nm;热漂账反推罩内温变率 ≤0.4 K/h(cryoem『要稳不要冷』重演)。收口 3.0 nm < 5 nm 任务。
断口学与尘形貌的服务面口径不变:韧窝=超载、解理河流纹=氢脆(foundry 竖炉氢残留的第一报警器)、疲劳辉纹读裂纹步进;火星尘棱角+静电吸附是 0.25%/sol 擦不掉的原因——形貌照片是原始证据。
sim_en: **Device layer, round three (L3, COMSOL electrostatics -- ledgers D-G1/G3).** This card's probe-size ladder rests entirely on the brightness column of a specification table, so the column was rebuilt: Richardson-Dushman for the thermionic emitters, Schottky lowering on a COMSOL-solved apex field for the field emitter, and the Langmuir limit to turn current density into brightness. **W 3.9e4 / LaB6 6.7e5 / Schottky 1.65e8 A/cm2/sr against the assumed 1e5 / 1e6 / 1e8 -- worst agreement 2.6x, across seven decades and three different mechanisms.** The field factor comes out at **k = 5.98** against a textbook 5. **S1's ladder stands on physics, not on a catalogue** -- a confirming result is worth as much as an overturning one, it is just quieter. What the table hid is WHY the Schottky wins: not that it emits harder, but that it emits harder while running 900 K colder, and B = JeV/(pi k T) charges for both. **The lifetime column did not survive (frame correction #4).** Gate S1c read 'only Schottky lifetime spans a 26-month resupply window' -- 18,000 h against 19,000 h **does not span it**, falls 1,000 h short, and is a median besides, so half the emitters are gone before it; a spare ships either way. Mass is not the argument (253 g for all three, freight noise) and neither is downtime (2.0% of the calendar at worst, against a room whose busiest line runs at rho 0.375). **What survives is a metrological argument the original never made**: a new emitter is a new beam, and probe current, spot size and detector solid angle all have to be re-established -- **127 recalibrations per window** on tungsten, 13 on LaB6, **1.1** on Schottky, every one of them drawn on ledger F's locally prepared standards. The argument was never freight or hours; it is that a stable beam is a metrological asset and the cheap emitters spend it. Sharper still: the 18,000 h is **a vacuum specification wearing an emitter's clothes**. It scales as 1/P and is quoted at 1e-7 Pa; one decade of loss makes it **1,800 h**, no better than LaB6. The ion pump at the gun is not decoration -- it is the entire basis of that lifetime.

Five ledgers distilled (mars-analytic sim/sem, 20 gates green). The Martian gun ledger (S1): W 150 h, LaB6 1,500 h, Schottky 18,000 h - against a 19,000 h synodic window only the field emitter's lifetime spans a resupply cycle; tungsten ships cheap by the gram but every 150 h swap is a vent-bake-pumpdown day, 120 lost days per window. Brightness agrees: EDS wants 1 nA inside 10 nm - W 59 nm / LaB6 25 / FEG 5. Only the FEG passes both.

Electron-solid MC (S2, single-scattering + CSDA): the eta ladder Fe 0.32 / basalt 0.17 / gypsum 0.15 IS the BSE contrast mechanism. The dust discipline: z99 at 15 kV is 1.8 um - guaranteed punch-through of a 1 um fine-mode grain (zero-margin graze even at 2 um); 5 kV stays at 0.27 um with 3.7x containment. Dust morphology and dust EDS run at 5 kV, or the stub answers for the grain. The fine print of the pwr-storage-01 / sci-ir-01 dust evidence chain.

Two Martian EDS rules (S3): S Ka 2.307 and Mo La 2.293 sit 14 eV apart - one peak at 125 eV SDD resolution, so **molybdenum stubs are forbidden in a sulfur planet's lab**; Fe La and F Ka (28 eV) smear likewise - fluorine assays in Fe-rich matrix belong to the IC line. MDL 0.16 wt% vs the ICP's ug/L is five orders: EDS answers WHAT IS THIS GRAIN, ICP answers HOW CLEAN IS THIS WATER.

**Device layer (L3, ledger D-S3): what really separates the room's two silicon detectors is not linewidth.** TCAD puts the strip's leakage at **double per 7.5 K** (2.6 / 167 / 931 pA solved at 253 / 293 / 313 K - the textbook silicon-detector number, and the same 7.5 K that phase-x reconstructed on a completely different device). Cooling does not buy noise, it buys **integration time**: at 253 K the optimum shaper runs 7x longer and the linewidth goes 270 -> 151 eV. Meanwhile **97% of the SDD's 125 eV is silicon's own Fano statistics** - it already sits at the physics floor - and a cooled strip at the same shaping reaches 157 eV, only 30% behind. So the room needs two detectors for **geometry and duty** (solid angle at the stage, single-channel rate), not for resolution. **The harder consequence**: this card's two Martian rules - S Ka vs Mo La at 14 eV, Fe La vs F Ka at 28 eV - are **unresolvable by any silicon detector at all** (12% and 23% of even the SDD's width), which makes the no-molybdenum-stub rule and the fluorine-goes-to-IC rule absolute, not a function of how good the detector is.

VP mode = this instrument's planet-as-consumable card (S4): the ESEM window is 10-2000 Pa and the Martian surface sits at 600 Pa, inside it - Earth labs buy bottled CO2 as imaging gas; here it is one needle valve (hull line reversed, HEPA-filtered). At 3 mm gas path: 92% focused at 100 Pa, 62% even at full ambient. Insulating sulfates image uncoated, surface chemistry unburied by 10 nm of metal. The coater stays for sub-10-nm work.

Resolution rollup (S5, quadrature, the phase-x credo): the VC-D floor at 8 Hz is 124 nm of displacement; **a red gate taught the real lesson - the air-leg plinth alone leaves 4.5 nm, eating the whole 5 nm duty; the instrument's internal stage (f0 = 2 Hz, standard on FEG columns) is load-bearing, not packaging** - two stages in series give 0.3 nm; the drift ledger backs out <=0.4 K/h inside the hood (the cryoem's 'stability, not cold' re-lands). Rollup 3.0 nm < 5 nm duty.

Fractography and dust-morphology service unchanged: dimples = overload, river-pattern cleavage = hydrogen embrittlement (the first alarm for foundry shaft-furnace hydrogen), striation spacing reads crack advance; sharp charged Martian grains are why 0.25%/sol of soiling will not wipe off - the images are the primary evidence.
pois.physics: 电子的德布罗意波长在 20 kV 下只有 0.009 nm——比可见光短五万倍,这就是电镜看得见纳米的全部理由。但短波长的代价是电子必须在真空里飞、样品必须导电（绝缘样先镀金属膜）、而束斑在样品上的位置对振动敏感到微米级抖动即糊片——所以这台仪器的三张卡（本卡、真空卡、隔振卡）其实是同一台机器的三个面。
pois.physics_en: An electron's de Broglie wavelength at 20 kV is 0.009 nm - fifty thousand times shorter than visible light, which is the entire reason an electron microscope sees nanometres. The price of that wavelength: electrons must fly in vacuum, samples must conduct (insulators get sputtered metal first), and the probe's position on the sample is so vibration-sensitive that micron-level shake blurs the image - so this instrument's three cards (this one, vacuum, isolation) are three faces of one machine.

pois.label: 真空半价卡（行星就是前级泵）
pois.label_en: The vacuum half-price card (the planet is your backing pump)
pois.detail: 全册的反直觉主卡，就在这间泵房里。火星地表 600 Pa——这在地球真空目录里是要花钱买的『中粗真空』，两级旋片泵的工作区。SEM 和质谱的涡轮泵在地球必须配一台 400 W 前级泵昼夜连转，把排气压回一个大气压；在这里，宽域涡轮的排气极限（~1 kPa）本身就高于室外气压——排气管穿过舱壁直通行星，前级泵从机器清单上消失了。墙上那对橙色常闭阀、超流量止回阀和黄色警示板，是这笔便宜账的保险费。
pois.detail_en: The book's counter-intuitive lead card lives in this pump room. The Martian surface at 600 Pa is what Earth's vacuum catalogue sells as mid-rough vacuum - two-stage rotary-vane territory, bought with money. On Earth the SEM's and the quad's turbopumps each need a 400 W backing pump running day and night to push exhaust back up to an atmosphere; here, a wide-range turbo's exhaust tolerance (~1 kPa) already exceeds the pressure outdoors - the exhaust line runs through the hull straight to the planet, and the backing pump vanishes from the equipment list. The pair of orange normally-closed valves, the excess-flow check and the yellow hazard board on that wall are this bargain's insurance premium.

sim: **第三条诚实边界(账 D-G3e)。**SEM 枪区那台离子泵不是装饰。肖特基发射体的 18,000 h 寿命受离子轰击限制、按 1/P 走,标在 **1e-7 Pa**;掉一个数量级就只剩 1,800 h,不比 LaB₆ 好。**而 1e-7 Pa 正是本卡的红利够不着的地方**——600 Pa 的火星大气给涡轮省掉一台 24 h 连转的前级泵(本卡主线),在超高真空这边**一分钱不给**:那里要的是离子泵、金属密封和烘烤,而且与舱外压强毫无关系。**行星在粗真空慷慨,在超高真空漠不关心。**同一本账第三次划边界,也是最锋利的一次。

**本轮多了一个客户,但绕了个弯(账 D-C5)。**CCD 要冷到 −71 °C。先前以为干氩吹扫的密封壳就够——错:10 Pa 以上气体导热处在连续区、**与压强无关**,吹扫壳往冷头带进 123 mW,而三级珀尔帖在这个温差只抬得动 87 mW;只有真杜瓦(1e-2 Pa 时 0.12 mW)才闭合。于是**真空半价在这里第二次兑现,却不是靠「排到火星大气」**——是靠本账原本证明的那件事:涡轮直排、前级泵消失,所以杜瓦可以**一直抽着**,而不必密封+吸气剂+每一到三年重抽(那个周期正好压在 26 个月的补给架上)。伸手去够行星当保温层是错的;行星是从本账已经证明的那个机制上帮的忙——和账 A2 当年那次自我修正同一个教训:窗口红利是真的,得记在对的科目上。
自我修正,原样入卡（mars-analytic 账 A,首版红闸）：曾把『600 Pa 白送』记在抽气时间上——错。仪器在 70 kPa 增压舱内,粗抽段的长度由舱压决定,行星只接管 2 kPa 以下,同一台泵两个行星只差 79 秒对 92 秒。真空半价省的不是秒,是那台 24 小时连转的前级泵。便宜账要算在对的科目上。
样品室是一个小气闸：直接把 50 L 舱气排给行星,每循环丢 47 g（折 0.25 kWh 的缓冲气重造电）——所以先用回收泵抽回舱内到 2 kPa（回收 97%,与 res-eclss-01 气闸泵同一条 23:1 的账）,再切穿舱管线。膜下真空到高真空的最后一段,才轮到行星白送。
诚实边界——穿舱不是免费的：这根 DN25 管让 70 kPa 的舱与 600 Pa 的行星只隔两只阀。破口即 0.53 kg/s 的失压流,相当于给地下城多开了一个常设漏点。规程是穿舱段双常闭气动阀（断电即关）+ 超流量止回阀 + 管容压到 2 L 以下;此账不写,半价卡就是虚账。
省电账的量级要老实报：19.7 kWh/sol 对城网是零头,它的真正价值是清单上少两台会坏的泵、机房少 800 W 的连续热负荷、和涡轮背压永远比地球规格宽裕一个量级的可靠性余量。
sim_en: **Third honest boundary (ledger D-G3e).** The ion pump at the SEM gun is not decoration. A Schottky emitter's 18,000 h life is set by ion bombardment and scales as 1/P, quoted at **1e-7 Pa**; one decade of loss leaves 1,800 h, no better than LaB6. **And 1e-7 Pa is exactly where this card's windfall does not reach** -- 600 Pa of Mars atmosphere deletes a backing pump that would otherwise run 24 h a sol (this card's headline) and pays **nothing at all** at ultra-high vacuum, which needs an ion pump, metal seals and a bake-out, and has no relationship to the pressure outside the hull. **The planet is generous at rough vacuum and indifferent at ultra-high.** Third boundary drawn on the same ledger, and the sharpest.

**One more customer this round, by an indirect route (ledger D-C5).** The CCD must be held at -71 C. A dry-argon purged housing was the first answer and it is wrong: above ~10 Pa gas conduction is in the continuum regime and **independent of pressure**, so a purged enclosure carries 123 mW into a cold head that a three-stage Peltier can only relieve of 87 mW at this dT. Only a real dewar closes it (0.12 mW at 1e-2 Pa). So the vacuum windfall pays a second time here -- **but not by venting to Mars**. It pays through what this ledger actually established: the turbo exhausts straight to ambient with no backing pump, so the dewar can simply stay pumped instead of being sealed behind a getter and re-pumped every one to three years -- an interval that lands squarely on the 26-month resupply shelf. Reaching for the planet as insulation was the error; the planet helps through the mechanism this ledger had already proved. Ledger A2's lesson again: the windfall is real, and it must be booked against the right line.

A self-correction, published as committed (mars-analytic ledger A, first-draft red gate): the 600 Pa windfall was first booked against pump-down time - wrong. The instrument sits in a 70 kPa cabin, so roughdown length is set by cabin pressure; the planet only takes over below 2 kPa, and the same pump differs by just 79 versus 92 seconds between planets. What the half-price card saves is not seconds - it is the backing pump that runs 24 hours a day. A bargain must be booked to the right account.

The sample chamber is a small airlock: dumping 50 L of cabin gas to the planet loses 47 g per cycle (0.25 kWh of buffer-gas remanufacture) - so a recovery pump first pulls the chamber back into the cabin down to 2 kPa (97% recovered, the same 23:1 ledger as the res-eclss-01 airlock pumps), and only then does the hull line open. The planet's gift applies to the last leg only.

The honest boundary - hull penetration is not free: this DN25 line leaves two valves between a 70 kPa cabin and a 600 Pa planet. A rupture is a 0.53 kg/s depressurization path - a standing extra leak point for the undercity. The rule: double normally-closed pneumatic valves (power loss = closed), an excess-flow check, line volume under 2 L. Without this paragraph the half-price card would be cooked books.

And the savings reported at honest magnitude: 19.7 kWh/sol is a rounding error to the grid. The real value is two fewer failure-prone pumps on the inventory, 800 W less continuous heat in the room, and turbo backing margins an order of magnitude wider than Earth spec.
pois.physics: 真空工程的成本几乎全花在跨越大气压那九个数量级上,而成本按压比的对数分段计价。火星把起点从 101325 Pa 挪到 600 Pa——对数轴上白送了 2.2 个量级,恰好是最贵的那一段（机械泵段）。但增压舱又把仪器搬回了 70 kPa 的小地球,所以白送只兑现在排气侧:涡轮泵不再需要有人替它把气压回大气压。同一颗行星,对抽气的一端只是普通,对排气的一端是慷慨的——便宜账认方向。
pois.physics_en: Vacuum engineering spends nearly everything on the nine decades below one atmosphere, priced by the logarithm of pressure ratio. Mars moves the origin from 101,325 Pa to 600 Pa - 2.2 decades handed over free, and precisely the most expensive ones (the mechanical-pump decades). But the pressurized cabin puts the instrument back on a little 70 kPa Earth, so the gift is redeemed only on the exhaust side: no machine need push the turbo's exhaust back up to an atmosphere anymore. The same planet is merely ordinary to the intake side and generous to the exhaust side - a bargain that knows its direction.

pois.label: 隔振账（隔壁在打篮球）
pois.label_en: The isolation ledger (there is basketball next door)
pois.detail: SEM 脚下这三只橙色气浮腿和一块花岗岩,防的不是火震,是邻居——玄关左墙的下一扇门就是娱乐中心,那里每天有人从 1.32 米的高度落地。账算下来结论有两半:经 25 米玄武岩岩体传来的篮球落地只剩 0.054 µm/s,比 SEM 的 VC-D 地坪规格低两个量级,岩体本身就是隔振沟;但若两馆共用一条连续的走廊混凝土板,板内弯曲波几乎不衰减,坏情况 7 µm/s 直逼规格——所以早先把门槛处的全深度断缝定为设计要求。**这条已经撤回**——有限元把连续板、开缝板和干脆不铺板解了三遍,在足落频带里三者一致到 0.6%:板的弯曲波比玄武岩慢 20 倍,它向岩体辐射而不是导波,那条『低损二维波导』是土地基建筑的图景。真实足落到 SEM 是 1.6 µm/s,对规格有 3.9 倍余量。
pois.detail_en: The three orange air legs and the granite block under the SEM guard not against marsquakes but against the neighbours - the next door down the foyer's left wall is the recreation hall, where somebody lands from 1.32 metres every day. The ledger splits in two: through 25 metres of basalt a basketball landing arrives at 0.054 um/s, two orders below the SEM's VC-D floor spec - the rock itself is an isolation trench; but if the two halls shared one continuous corridor slab, bending waves in the plate barely attenuate and the bad case reaches 7 um/s, right at the spec - so a full-depth joint at this room's threshold was made a design requirement. **That has since been retracted** - a finite element model solved the corridor three ways (continuous slab, jointed slab, no slab at all) and the three agree to 0.6% across the footfall band: the slab's bending wave is 20x slower than basalt's shear wave, so it radiates into the rock rather than guiding along it, and the 'low-loss 2D waveguide' belongs to soil-founded buildings. The real footfall reaches the SEM at 1.6 um/s, 3.9x under spec.

sim: **撤回（L3，COMSOL 结构谐响应实解 · 账 D-E1）：本卡曾给总控下过一条施工要求（门槛处全深度断缝），现在它被求解器推翻了。**把走廊板+岩体建成平面应变模型，同一套参数解三遍——**连续板 / 开 20 mm 全深度缝 / 干脆不铺板**：25 m 处 8 Hz 分别是 4.033 / 4.027 / **4.016 µm/s**，在足落冲击的主频带（≤ 16 Hz）内三者一致到 **0.6%**，而断缝在整个扫频里只改变 **0.8%**。**把混凝土整个拿掉都几乎不影响结果，那么把它切开当然也不会。**原因干净得像一句话：板的弯曲波在 8 Hz 只有 **125 m/s**，而玄武岩剪切波是 **2491 m/s**（20 倍）——比基底慢得多的弯曲波会向基底**辐射**而不是导波。账 E 借来的“混凝土板是低损波导”是**土地基础建筑的图景**，25 m 玄武岩不是土。按真实半正弦冲击谱加权后，到达 SEM 的速度是 **1.6 µm/s**（同相叠加的上界），对 VC-D 的 6.25 有 3.9 倍余量，而平面应变本身还把点冲击高估了约一个走廊宽度。**结论：断缝不要修了。**诚实边界：24 Hz 以上板确实开始传（32 Hz 处 22%），所以这条撤回只管足落类源，不管直接螺在走廊板上的机器。

落地账（mars-analytic 账 E）：0.38 g 让人人起跳 1.32 m,但落地动量 mv 原价——低重力打折的是高度积累的速度（×0.62）,不是质量。4.2 kN 的峰值力经玄武岩半空间 G=ρVs²≈1.5×10¹⁰ Pa 摊薄,25 m 外只剩纳米每秒量级:刚度大三个量级的介质,同一脚踩下去响应小三个量级——这正是 sci-seis-01 说火星风化层噪声天生偏大的同一条物理,反着用。
〔已被上一段推翻，保留供追溯〕板传路径是真风险:走廊板是低刚度二维波导,弯曲波按 1/√r 慢衰减,粗账 7 µm/s 与规格同量级——模型粗糙没关系,结论只需要『不能排除』就足以要求断缝。断缝(隔振沟)是一条锯缝的成本,买掉一个量级的不确定性,这买卖不用犹豫。
〔已作废，保留供追溯〕对总控的落位输入,两选一:与 hab-rec-01 洞室岩柱间距 ≥15 m,或共用走廊板在本馆门槛做全深度断缝——**优先断缝**(反正门槛处本来要做沉降缝)。本馆自身的 24h 振源(泵间)已按裂变堆 §10 ⑯ 的弹性支座纪律自治,不向邻居出口振动。
已知答案闸:VC 曲线是半导体/电镜行业标准地坪谱(VC-A 50 → VC-E 3.12 µm/s);sci-cryoem-01 实测口径(城市规格 1.2e-6 m/s/√Hz@10m ≈ VC-D)直接沿用,两馆同一本底、同一套隔振语言。
SEM 深挖轮把这本账折成纳米（账 S5,红闸真发现）:VC-D 地板在 8 Hz = 124 nm 位移;气浮墩单级压到 4.5 nm——**吃掉全部 5 nm 成像任务余量,单级不够**;仪器机内第二级(f₀=2 Hz,FEG 厂标)串联后 0.3 nm,收口 3.0 nm。任务定深度:电镜两级、冷冻电镜三级、XRD 台装——这块花岗岩是必要条件,不是充分条件。
sim_en: **RETRACTION (L3, COMSOL structural harmonic - ledger D-E1): this card once handed the integrator a construction requirement (a full-depth isolation joint at the threshold), and a solver has now overturned it.** Building the corridor slab and its rock foundation in plane strain and solving the identical model three ways - **continuous slab / cut by a 20 mm full-depth joint / no slab at all** - gives 4.033 / 4.027 / **4.016 um/s** at 25 m and 8 Hz. Across the footfall's band (<= 16 Hz) the three agree to **0.6%**, and the joint changes the answer by **0.8%** anywhere in the sweep. **Deleting the concrete outright barely moves the result, so cutting it certainly cannot.** The reason is one line long: the slab's flexural wave runs at **125 m/s** at 8 Hz against basalt's **2491 m/s** shear wave - a bending wave far slower than its substrate radiates INTO it rather than guiding along it. The 'concrete slab as low-loss waveguide' picture ledger E borrowed belongs to soil-founded buildings, and 25 m of basalt is not soil. Weighted by the real half-sine footfall spectrum the velocity arriving at the SEM is **1.6 um/s** (an in-phase upper bound) against the 6.25 um/s VC-D floor - 3.9x of margin, with plane strain still overstating a point impact by about one corridor width. **The joint should not be built.** Honest limit: above 24 Hz the slab does begin to carry (22% at 32 Hz), so this retraction covers footfall-class sources, not machinery bolted to the corridor slab.

The landing ledger (mars-analytic ledger E): 0.38 g lets everyone jump 1.32 m, but landing momentum mv pays full price - low gravity discounts the speed gathered over height (x0.62), never the mass. The 4.2 kN peak spreads through a basalt half-space of G = rho Vs^2 = 1.5e10 Pa, arriving 25 m away at nanometres per second: a medium three orders stiffer answers the same footfall three orders quieter - the same physics by which sci-seis-01 calls Martian regolith natively noisy, run in reverse.

[SUPERSEDED by the paragraph above; kept for traceability] The slab path is the real risk: a corridor slab is a compliant two-dimensional waveguide where bending waves decay slowly as 1/sqrt(r); the rough ledger says ~7 um/s, the same order as spec. The model being crude is fine - the conclusion only needs 'cannot be excluded' to mandate the joint. A saw cut's worth of cost buys off an order of magnitude of uncertainty; that trade needs no deliberation.

[WITHDRAWN; kept for traceability] Siting input to the integrator, either-or: >= 15 m of rock pillar to the hab-rec-01 cavern, or a full-depth joint in the shared corridor slab at this room's threshold - **prefer the joint** (a settlement joint belongs at the threshold anyway). This room's own 24 h sources (the pump room) already govern themselves by the fission plant's section 10 item 16 mount discipline, exporting no vibration to the neighbours.

Known-answer gates: the VC curves are the semiconductor/EM industry's standard floor spectra (VC-A 50 down to VC-E 3.12 um/s); the sci-cryoem-01 measured caliber (city spec 1.2e-6 m/s/rtHz at 10 m, roughly VC-D) is reused directly - two labs, one floor, one isolation language.

The SEM deep-dive prices this ledger in nanometres (ledger S5, a red-gate finding): the VC-D floor at 8 Hz is 124 nm of displacement; the air-leg plinth alone leaves 4.5 nm - **eating the entire 5 nm imaging duty: one stage is NOT enough**; the instrument's internal stage (f0 = 2 Hz, standard on FEG columns) in series brings 0.3 nm, rollup 3.0 nm. Duty defines depth: two stages for the SEM, three for the cryo-EM, bench mounts for the XRD - this granite is a necessary condition, never a sufficient one.
pois.physics: 隔振的一切都是阻抗失配:振动能量在刚度突变的界面上反射而不是透射。岩柱是天然的失配(空气-岩-空气),断缝是人造的失配(板-缝-板),气浮腿是调出来的失配(1.5 Hz 平台对 10 Hz 以上的激励呈 40 倍衰减)。娱乐中心影院卡说 30 m 玄武岩把发射日噪声隔成了另一个星球——同一堵岩,那边用来看电影,这边用来看纳米。
pois.physics_en: All of vibration isolation is impedance mismatch: energy reflects rather than transmits wherever stiffness changes abruptly. A rock pillar is a natural mismatch (air-rock-air), a saw joint an artificial one (slab-gap-slab), an air leg a tuned one (a 1.5 Hz platform attenuates 10 Hz excitation forty-fold). The recreation hall's cinema card says 30 m of basalt puts launch-day noise on another planet - the same rock that lets one side watch films lets this side watch nanometres.
